Plugin_fc9843a6fb34819195d6c7802398a8a7.longDescription:
Data helps you turn questions about your product or business into answers you can trust. Ask why a metric changed, what the data shows about where a team should focus next, how to define KPIs, whether a dataset is reliable, or how large an opportunity might be, and it can help you investigate the data and turn the findings into shareable reports, charts, dashboards, notebooks, and recommendations.

Start with the data you already have: connected warehouses, BI or product analytics tools, docs, chats, spreadsheets, uploaded files, pasted results, or clearly labeled sample data. The plugin guides you through the right workflow, checks sources where possible, and keeps the evidence visible in reviewable tables, charts, dashboards, and report apps you can share.

You can also turn metric-definition links, dashboard and report examples, design references, and working preferences into reusable Data context, then package it for personal or team use.
Plugin_fc9843a6fb34819195d6c7802398a8a7.longDescriptionZh:
数据可以帮助您将有关产品或业务的问题转化为您可以信任的答案。询问指标为何发生变化、数据显示了团队接下来应该关注的内容、如何定义 KPI、数据集是否可靠或机会可能有多大，它可以帮助您调查数据并将结果转化为可共享的报告、图表、仪表板、笔记本和建议。

从您已有的数据开始：连接的仓库、BI 或产品分析工具、文档、聊天、电子表格、上传的文件、粘贴的结果或明确标记的示例数据。该插件引导您完成正确的工作流程，尽可能检查来源，并使证据在您可以共享的可审查表格、图表、仪表板和报告应用程序中保持可见。

您还可以将指标定义链接、仪表板和报告示例、设计参考和工作首选项转换为可重用的数据上下文，然后将其打包以供个人或团队使用。
Plugin_fc9843a6fb34819195d6c7802398a8a7.productIntro: Data 是 OpenAI 提供的数据分析插件，可连接已有数据仓库、商业智能工具与文档，调查业务指标变化，并把结果整理成图表、报表或建议。
Plugin_fc9843a6fb34819195d6c7802398a8a7.productIntroEn: Data is a service that helps you answer questions with data. In Codex, it is most useful when a task needs the service’s information or actions to be combined with reasoning, files, or other tools.
defaultPrompts: Help me get started with my first data task
Analyze product or business data and recommend where to focus next
Turn my metric links and working preferences into reusable Data context
defaultPromptsZh: 帮助我开始我的第一个数据任务
分析产品或业务数据并建议下一步重点关注的领域
将我的指标链接和工作首选项转变为可重用的数据上下文
Plugin_fc9843a6fb34819195d6c7802398a8a7.bestFor: 有明确输入、输出和验收标准的重复性 Codex 工作流。
Plugin_fc9843a6fb34819195d6c7802398a8a7.bestForEn: Repeatable Codex workflows with clear inputs, outputs, and acceptance criteria.
Plugin_fc9843a6fb34819195d6c7802398a8a7.notFor: 目标模糊、没有验收标准，或只是希望 AI 凭空增加“创造力”的任务。
Plugin_fc9843a6fb34819195d6c7802398a8a7.notForEn: Ambiguous goals without acceptance criteria, or tasks where you only want the AI to add vague “creativity”.

plugin_asdk_app_69a880b0d024819182db60f3.longDescription:
Query live blockchain data across 90+ EVM-compatible blockchain networks directly in ChatGPT. Blockscout gives you instant access to wallet balances, transaction histories, token holdings, NFTs, smart contract source code, and contract ABIs, no API keys required.

Ask questions in plain English: "What tokens does this wallet hold?", "Show me recent transactions on this contract", or "Resolve this ENS name." Blockscout handles the lookup and returns structured, accurate on-chain data in seconds.
plugin_asdk_app_69a880b0d024819182db60f3.longDescriptionZh:
直接在 ChatGPT 中查询跨 90 多个 EVM 兼容区块链网络的实时区块链数据。 Blockscout 让您可以即时访问钱包余额、交易历史、代币持有量、NFT、智能合约源代码和合约 ABI，无需 API 密钥。

用简单的英语提问：“这个钱包持有什么代币？”、“显示此合约的最近交易”或“解析此 ENS 名称”。 Blockscout 处理查找并在几秒钟内返回结构化、准确的链上数据。
plugin_asdk_app_69a880b0d024819182db60f3.productIntro: Blockscout 是区块链浏览与数据平台，可查询多个 EVM 网络上的钱包、交易、代币、NFT 和智能合约信息。

plugin_asdk_app_69a2327e44fc8191ace64618.productIntroEn: BlazeSQL lets ChatGPT and Codex query your database or warehouse with all the necessary context to get the correct answers.
plugin_asdk_app_69a2327e44fc8191ace64618.longDescription:
BlazeSQL lets ChatGPT and Codex query your database or warehouse with all the necessary context to get the correct answers.

Connect to Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, AWS Athena, MariaDB, SQL Anywhere, Databricks, Clickhouse, and Oracle.

With context management, observability, and comprehensive access controls, BlazeSQL turns ChatGPT or Codex into an enterprise-ready AI Data Analyst for reliable self-service across your entire company.

As a comprehensive Business Intelligence layer, BlazeSQL also enables visualization, dashboards, advanced statistical analysis, predictive analytics, scheduled reports, and custom PDF or interactive HTML reports.
plugin_asdk_app_69a2327e44fc8191ace64618.longDescriptionZh:
BlazeSQL 让 ChatGPT 和 Codex 使用所有必要的上下文查询您的数据库或仓库，以获得正确的答案。

连接到 Snowflake、BigQuery、Redshift、Microsoft SQL Server、PostgreSQL、MySQL、AWS Athena、MariaDB、SQL Anywhere、Databricks、Clickhouse 和 Oracle。

凭借上下文管理、可观察性和全面的访问控制，BlazeSQL 将 ChatGPT 或 Codex 转变为企业级 AI 数据分析师，为整个公司提供可靠的自助服务。

作为全面的商业智能层，BlazeSQL 还支持可视化、仪表板、高级统计分析、预测分析、计划报告以及自定义 PDF 或交互式 HTML 报告。

plugin_asdk_app_698ccc7e538481918e437360.description: 无需询问即可获得答案
plugin_asdk_app_698ccc7e538481918e437360.productIntro: Connect AI 可与云数据仓库、关系数据库、数据湖站、分析平台等配合使用，因此您可以通过对话探索和分析数据。使用您的数据作为您在 ChatGPT 中所做的工作的输入，例如将产品遥测与发布计划相关联以调查用户参与度。在 Connect AI 中，您可以跨具有定义的关系和语义上下文的源构建虚拟数据集，并将它们呈现为专用工具 - 因此 ChatGPT 以您的企业理解的方式处理您的数据，而不仅仅是其存储方式。
plugin_asdk_app_698ccc7e538481918e437360.productIntroEn: Connect AI works with cloud data warehouses, relational databases, data lakehouses, analytics platforms and more so you can explore and analyze your data through conversation. Use your data as input to the work you're doing in ChatGPT, like correlating product telemetry with the release schedule to investigate user engagement.
plugin_asdk_app_698ccc7e538481918e437360.longDescription: Connect AI works with cloud data warehouses, relational databases, data lakehouses, analytics platforms and more so you can explore and analyze your data through conversation. Use your data as input to the work you're doing in ChatGPT, like correlating product telemetry with the release schedule to investigate user engagement. In Connect AI, you build virtual datasets across sources with defined relationships and semantic context, and surface them as purpose-built tools – so ChatGPT works with your data the way your business understands it, not just the way it’s stored. IT admins control access and monitor every query with full audit trails — so the right people reach the right data, nothing more.
plugin_asdk_app_698ccc7e538481918e437360.longDescriptionZh: Connect AI 可与云数据仓库、关系数据库、数据湖站、分析平台等配合使用，因此您可以通过对话探索和分析数据。使用您的数据作为您在 ChatGPT 中所做的工作的输入，例如将产品遥测与发布计划相关联以调查用户参与度。在 Connect AI 中，您可以跨具有定义的关系和语义上下文的源构建虚拟数据集，并将它们呈现为专用工具 - 因此 ChatGPT 以您的企业理解的方式处理您的数据，而不仅仅是其存储方式。 IT 管理员通过完整的审核跟踪来控制访问并监控每个查询，以便正确的人员获得正确的数据，仅此而已。

plugin_asdk_app_696a54f1c91c81919002b915.productIntro: 将 AI 助手连接到您的 MotherDuck 数据仓库。使用自然语言探索、可视化和管理数据——无需 SQL 技能。创建潜水：交互式可视化，可让您保存并与团队共享答案，了解最新数据。无需语义模型或​​预配置即可处理现实世界的数据。您的人工智能助手就像数据分析师一样，反复探索、验证、分析和可视化数据来回答您的问题。
plugin_asdk_app_696a54f1c91c81919002b915.productIntroEn: Connect AI assistants to your MotherDuck data warehouse. Explore, visualize, and manage data using natural language–no SQL skills required. plugin_asdk_app_6939ea66e1588191af5f9d2a.name: Coupler.io
plugin_asdk_app_6939ea66e1588191af5f9d2a.description: 分析来自 400 多个应用程序的数据
plugin_asdk_app_6939ea66e1588191af5f9d2a.productIntro: 通过连接到 Coupler.io 数据流，分析 Codex 中的多渠道营销、财务、销售、电子商务和其他业务数据。从 Google Ads、Facebook、HubSpot 和 Salesforce 等平台获取原始数据并将其转换为可操作的情报，从而利用准确、最新的业务信息做出更智能、更快速的决策。
plugin_asdk_app_6939ea66e1588191af5f9d2a.productIntroEn: Analyze multi-channel marketing, financial, sales, e-commerce, and other business data within Codex by connecting to your Coupler.io data flows. Fetch and transform raw data from platforms like Google Ads, Facebook, HubSpot, and Salesforce into actionable intelligence for smarter, faster decision-making with accurate, up-to-date business information.
plugin_asdk_app_6939ea66e1588191af5f9d2a.longDescription:
Analyze multi-channel marketing, financial, sales, e-commerce, and other business data within Codex by connecting to your Coupler.io data flows. Fetch and transform raw data from platforms like Google Ads, Facebook, HubSpot, and Salesforce into actionable intelligence for smarter, faster decision-making with accurate, up-to-date business information.

You can use the Coupler.io connector to:

1. Analyze customer acquisition costs: "What's our overall customer acquisition cost across all paid channels this quarter compared to last quarter? I need this for the board meeting"
2. Review marketing ROI: "Show me the ROI breakdown by marketing channel for the past 6 months. I need to reallocate our annual budget"
3. Identify high-performing campaigns:"Which campaigns are contributing most to our pipeline revenue? I want to double down on what's working"
4. Review sales pipeline: "Can you pull the sales pipeline report for this month? I need to see how many deals are in each stage and the total value at each stage"
5. Analyze conversion rates: "What are our conversion rates from lead to opportunity and from opportunity to closed-won for the last quarter? How do they compare to our targets?"
6. Forecast revenue: "How many deals are expected to close this month based on their probability scores? What's our forecasted revenue vs our monthly target?"
7. Compare quarterly profits: "Check the profit for this quarter, compare it to last quarter, and provide a breakdown by department"
8. Generate cash flow reports: "Could you provide a cash flow report for the last 30 days, including all incoming and outgoing transactions?"
9. Review accounts receivable: "Share the current accounts receivable status and tell me how many overdue invoices we have and which customers owe the most"
plugin_asdk_app_6939ea66e1588191af5f9d2a.longDescriptionZh:
通过连接到 Coupler.io 数据流，分析 Codex 中的多渠道营销、财务、销售、电子商务和其他业务数据。从 Google Ads、Facebook、HubSpot 和 Salesforce 等平台获取原始数据并将其转换为可操作的情报，从而利用准确、最新的业务信息做出更智能、更快速的决策。

您可以使用 Coupler.io 连接器来：

1. 分析客户获取成本：“与上季度相比，本季度所有付费渠道的总体客户获取成本是多少？我需要这个来参加董事会会议”
2. 审查营销投资回报率：“显示过去 6 个月按营销渠道划分的投资回报率明细。我需要重新分配我们的年度预算”
3. 确定高效的营销活动：“哪些营销活动对我们的渠道收入贡献最大？我想在有效的营销活动上加倍努力”
4. 查看销售渠道：“你能拉一下这个月的销售渠道报告吗？我需要看看每个阶段有多少笔交易以及每个阶段的总价值”
5. 分析转化率：“上个季度我们从销售线索到机会以及从机会到成交的转化率是多少？与我们的目标相比如何？”
6. 预测收入：“根据概率得分，预计本月将完成多少笔交易？我们的预测收入与每月目标是多少？”
7、季度利润比较：“查看本季度利润，与上季度比较，并提供按部门明细”
8. 生成现金流量报告：“您能否提供最近 30 天的现金流量报告，包括所有进出交易？”
9.审核应收账款：“分享当前应收账款状态，告诉我我们有多少张逾期发票，哪些客户欠款最多”
defaultPrompts: Show overall spend, impressions, clicks, and CPC
defaultPromptsZh: 显示总体支出、展示次数、点击次数和每次点击费用

plugin_asdk_app_6a10afd73e7c81919bf3abc5.name: Porter Metrics
plugin_asdk_app_6a10afd73e7c81919bf3abc5.productIntro: Porter 将您的营销和电子商务数据导入 ChatGPT。连接来自 Facebook Ads、Google Ads、Shopify、GA4、TikTok Ads、LinkedIn Ads 和 Porter 中其他支持平台的帐户，然后用简单的英语提出问题 - “上周哪些营销活动带来了最多的收入？”、“昨天各个渠道的支出比较如何？” — 并从您的授权帐户中实时获取答案。
plugin_asdk_app_6a10afd73e7c81919bf3abc5.productIntroEn: Porter brings your marketing and ecommerce data into ChatGPT. Connect accounts from Facebook Ads, Google Ads, Shopify, GA4, TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads, and other supported platforms in Porter, then ask questions in plain English — "Which campaigns drove the most revenue last week?", "How did spend compare across channels yesterday?" — and get answers pulled live from your authorized accoun…
plugin_asdk_app_6a10afd73e7c81919bf3abc5.longDescription:
Porter brings your marketing and ecommerce data into ChatGPT. Connect accounts from Facebook Ads, Google Ads, Shopify, GA4, TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads, and other supported platforms in Porter, then ask questions in plain English — "Which campaigns drove the most revenue last week?", "How did spend compare across channels yesterday?" — and get answers pulled live from your authorized accounts.

Compare performance across platforms using unified metrics like clicks and spend, even when the underlying numbers come from different sources.

When you need the data outside the chat, schedule recurring exports of any query to a BigQuery table — Porter handles the cron and the schema, so your dashboards and warehouse stay in sync.
plugin_asdk_app_6a10afd73e7c81919bf3abc5.longDescriptionZh:
Porter 将您的营销和电子商务数据导入 ChatGPT。连接来自 Facebook Ads、Google Ads、Shopify、GA4、TikTok Ads、LinkedIn Ads 和 Porter 中其他支持平台的帐户，然后用简单的英语提出问题 - “上周哪些营销活动带来了最多的收入？”、“昨天各个渠道的支出比较如何？” — 并从您的授权帐户中实时获取答案。

即使基础数字来自不同来源，也可以使用点击次数和支出等统一指标来比较跨平台的性能。

当您需要聊天之外的数据时，可以安排将任何查询定期导出到 BigQuery 表 - Porter 会处理 cron 和架构，以便您的仪表板和仓库保持同步。

plugin_asdk_app_6a4674940e1881918a0c7560.name: GIS Cloud
plugin_asdk_app_6a4674940e1881918a0c7560.description: 创建地图和 GIS 分析
plugin_asdk_app_6a4674940e1881918a0c7560.productIntro: GIS Cloud 是一个云地理空间平台，被 60 多个国家/地区的政府、公用事业和现场团队使用。
plugin_asdk_app_6a4674940e1881918a0c7560.productIntroEn: GIS Cloud is a cloud geospatial platform used by governments, utilities, and field teams in 60+ countries.
plugin_asdk_app_6a4674940e1881918a0c7560.longDescription:
GIS Cloud is a cloud geospatial platform used by governments, utilities, and field teams in 60+ countries. 

This app lets you work with your GIS Cloud account in plain language, no GIS expertise or clicking through menus required.

Ask ChatGPT to build and edit maps, create and style layers, add or query features, run spatial analysis, design mobile data collection forms for field teams, import datasets, and generate reports. It covers the full GIS workflow, from field capture to mapping, analysis, and reporting.

What you can do:
- Create, update, and organize maps and layers
- Add, edit, and query features and attribute data
- Run spatial analysis and compute statistics on your data
- Build and manage Mobile Data Collection forms for field teams
- Import files and manage datasets
- Generate reports from your geospatial data

You stay in control. GIS Cloud uses a propose-and-confirm model: changes are proposed before anything is written to your account, and destructive actions are clearly flagged. Access is scoped to your account through secure OAuth, with read-only operations separated from writes.

Works with your existing GIS Cloud account. New to GIS Cloud? Sign up free at giscloud.com.
plugin_asdk_app_6a4674940e1881918a0c7560.longDescriptionZh:
GIS Cloud 是一个云地理空间平台，被 60 多个国家/地区的政府、公用事业和现场团队使用。 

该应用程序可让您以简单的语言使用 GIS 云帐户，无需 GIS 专业知识或单击菜单。

要求 ChatGPT 构建和编辑地图、创建图层并设计图层样式、添加或查询要素、运行空间分析、为现场团队设计移动数据收集表单、导入数据集以及生成报告。它涵盖了完整的 GIS 工作流程，从现场捕获到绘图、分析和报告。

你可以做什么：
- 创建、更新和组织地图和图层
- 添加、编辑和查询要素和属性数据
- 对数据运行空间分析并计算统计数据
- 为现场团队构建和管理移动数据收集表格
- 导入文件并管理数据集
- 从您的地理空间数据生成报告

您保持掌控。 GIS Cloud 使用建议和确认模型：在将任何内容写入您的帐户之前提出更改建议，并明确标记破坏性操作。通过安全 OAuth 将访问权限限制在您的帐户范围内，只读操作与写入操作分开。

可与您现有的 GIS 云帐户配合使用。 GIS 云新手？在 giscloud.com 免费注册。

Ask about any game and get scores, schedules, standings, box scores, rosters, and player lookups across NBA, WNBA, MLB, NFL, NHL, KBO, NCAA basketball and football, and major soccer competitions including the Premier League, all normalized into one consistent shape, with numbers landing within minute…
plugin_asdk_app_6a736fa1def48191af5a8f0c.longDescription:
StatsHawk gives ChatGPT real, current sports data instead of guesses from training data. Ask about any game and get scores, schedules, standings, box scores, rosters, and player lookups across NBA, WNBA, MLB, NFL, NHL, KBO, NCAA basketball and football, and major soccer competitions including the Premier League, all normalized into one consistent shape, with numbers landing within minutes of box scores posting.

Beyond the basics: MLB pitch-by-pitch with Statcast detail (pitch type, velocity, launch data, filterable to a batter-pitcher matchup) and pre-computed player prop analysis, season, recent, and home/away averages with hit rates against any line, built for fantasy research, start/sit calls, and matchup prep.

Sign in with a free StatsHawk account when you connect; no API key to manage. Free includes 5,000 usage credits monthly and every standard stat tool. Prop analysis comes with paid plans.
plugin_asdk_app_6a736fa1def48191af5a8f0c.longDescriptionZh:
StatsHawk 为 ChatGPT 提供真实的当前运动数据，而不是根据训练数据进行猜测。询问任何一场比赛，并获取 NBA、WNBA、MLB、NFL、NHL、KBO、NCAA 篮球和橄榄球以及包括英超联赛在内的主要足球比赛的比分、赛程表、排名、统计数据、名单和球员查询，所有这些都标准化为一个一致的形状，统计数据在统计数据发布后几分钟内即可到达。

超越基础：MLB 逐个投球，包含 Statcast 详细信息（投球类型、速度、发射数据、可过滤至击球手与投手对决）和预先计算的球员道具分析、赛季、近期和主/客场平均值以及针对任何线路的命中率，专为幻想研究、开始/坐席呼叫和比赛准备而构建。

连接时使用免费的 StatsHawk 帐户登录；无需管理 API 密钥。免费包括每月 5,000 个使用积分和每个标准统计工具。道具分析附带付费计划。

plugin_asdk_app_69ef657024848191b86f9434.name: PagePulse
plugin_asdk_app_69ef657024848191b86f9434.description: 跟踪 SEO 和页面更改
plugin_asdk_app_69ef657024848191b86f9434.productIntro: PagePulse 将您的 Google Search Console 数据、Google Analytics 4 指标以及检测到的页面更改历史记录引入 ChatGPT。按项目、页面或主题询问您的网站，并根据您的实际分析获得答案。 独特的角度是相关性。 PagePulse 跟踪检测到的每一项页面更改（标题重写、内容更新、架构编辑、链接更改），并按重要性对每一项进行评分。
plugin_asdk_app_69ef657024848191b86f9434.productIntroEn: PagePulse brings your Google Search Console data, Google Analytics 4 metrics, and detected on-page change history into ChatGPT. Ask about your sites by project, page, or topic and get answers grounded in your actual analytics. The unique angle is correlation.
plugin_asdk_app_69ef657024848191b86f9434.longDescription:
PagePulse brings your Google Search Console data, Google Analytics 4 metrics, and detected on-page change history into ChatGPT. Ask about your sites by project, page, or topic and get answers grounded in your actual analytics.
The unique angle is correlation. PagePulse tracks every detected change to your pages — title rewrites, content updates, schema edits, link changes — and scores each one by importance. So when you ask "why did traffic drop on the pricing page last week?", ChatGPT can pull the analytics, surface the relevant page changes, and show you which edits lined up with the shift.
Use it to investigate traffic dips, audit what's been changing across your site, find the queries driving impressions to a specific page, browse pages by tag, or get a quick read on how a project is performing — without switching between dashboards.
plugin_asdk_app_69ef657024848191b86f9434.longDescriptionZh:
PagePulse 将您的 Google Search Console 数据、Google Analytics 4 指标以及检测到的页面更改历史记录引入 ChatGPT。按项目、页面或主题询问您的网站，并根据您的实际分析获得答案。
独特的角度是相关性。 PagePulse 跟踪检测到的每一项页面更改（标题重写、内容更新、架构编辑、链接更改），并按重要性对每一项进行评分。因此，当您询问“为什么上周定价页面上的流量下降？”时，ChatGPT 可以提取分析，显示相关页面更改，并向您显示哪些编辑与转变一致。
使用它来调查流量下降、审核整个网站的变化、查找推动特定页面展示的查询、按标签浏览页面或快速了解项目的执行情况，而无需在仪表板之间切换。
defaultPrompts: How is my site sampleweighting.com doing in search?
defaultPromptsZh: 我的网站 exampleweighting.com 在搜索中的表现如何？

plugin_asdk_app_69e5be7461d88191814dabae.productIntro: 为英国房地产专业人士提供的 Propalt 房地产数据和见解。 人工智能支持单个房产和整个投资组合的房产估值 (AMV)。 实时和历史的房地产销售和租赁数据，包括可比数据。 位置洞察，包括便利性、风险、学校、犯罪、公共和私人服务。 位置和市场分析显示历史趋势和预测。 编制HPI、EPC、土地注册处和门户列表数据等公共指数。 永久业权和租赁业权所有权查询，包括租赁信息。 房东见解，包括所有权详细信息、投资组合估值和见解。
plugin_asdk_app_69e5be7461d88191814dabae.productIntroEn: Propalt property data & insights for UK real estate professionals. AI powered property valuations (AMV) for individual property and whole portfolios. Live and historic real estate selling and renting data including comparables. Location insights including convenience, risks, schools, crime, public & private services. Location & market analytics showing historic trends and predictions.
plugin_asdk_app_69e5be7461d88191814dabae.longDescription:
Propalt property data & insights for UK real estate professionals. 
AI powered property valuations (AMV) for individual property and whole portfolios.
Live and historic real estate selling and renting data including comparables.
Location insights including convenience, risks, schools, crime, public & private services.
Location & market analytics showing historic trends and predictions.
Compiled public indices such as HPI, EPC, Land Registry, and portal listing data . 
Freehold & leasehold ownership queries including lease information.
Landlord insights including ownership details, portfolio valuations & insights. 
Real Estate data and workflows to enhance your objectives using your Propalt API key & subscription
Use with other apps such as Canva to create property data rich publications such as valuation reports, market insights and other marketing material.

位置洞察，包括便利性、风险、学校、犯罪、公共和私人服务。

与 Canva 等其他应用程序一起使用，创建包含丰富房地产数据的出版物，例如估值报告、市场洞察和其他营销材料。

plugin_asdk_app_6a1024ca5d808191ba16d990.name: Sometrend
plugin_asdk_app_6a1024ca5d808191ba16d990.longDescription:
Discover hidden trends with ease.

You don’t need data analysis experience to get started. Sometrend is your AI-powered social data partner, helping anyone quickly uncover meaningful insights and understand public reactions behind emerging trends.

Simply ask in your own words, like “Analyze the latest zero-sugar beverage trend,” and Sometrend will analyze vast amounts of social data to reveal the context and meaning behind the trend.

Turn trends into opportunities in ChatGPT and create new success.

This service does not perform analysis for the purpose of identifying individuals; it focuses on statistical and contextual analysis of social content. Excerpts from original posts or external links may be provided to aid understanding of the analysis results, but these are offered solely as internal references for analysis.
plugin_asdk_app_6a1024ca5d808191ba16d990.longDescriptionZh:
轻松发现隐藏的趋势。

您不需要数据分析经验即可开始。 Sometrend 是您的人工智能驱动的社交数据合作伙伴，帮助任何人快速发现有意义的见解并了解新兴趋势背后的公众反应。

只需用您自己的话提出问题，例如“分析最新的零糖饮料趋势”，Sometrend 将分析大量社交数据，以揭示趋势背后的背景和含义。

在ChatGPT将趋势转化为机遇，创造新的成功。

该服务不执行以识别个人身份为目的的分析；它侧重于社交内容的统计和情境分析。可以提供原始帖子或外部链接的摘录以帮助理解分析结果，但这些仅作为分析的内部参考。
defaultPrompts: Sometrend로 제로음료가 최근 3개월 내 네이버블로그에서 얼마나 언급됐는지 분석해줘.

Landstack MCP connects your AI model directly to UK land, planning and development data. plugin_asdk_app_6a8ebd56a408819189228d0b.name: InsightfulPipe
plugin_asdk_app_6a8ebd56a408819189228d0b.productIntro: InsightfulPipe 是一个营销工作区，可将 ChatGPT 连接到您的企业已使用的营销、分析、SEO、社交媒体和电子商务平台。用简单的语言提出问题、检索实时数据、创建报告并执行支持的操作，而无需手动导出和合并电子表格。
plugin_asdk_app_6a8ebd56a408819189228d0b.productIntroEn: InsightfulPipe is a marketing workspace that connects ChatGPT to the marketing, analytics, SEO, social media, and e-commerce platforms your business already uses. Ask questions in plain language, retrieve live data, create reports, and perform supported actions without manually exporting and combining spreadsheets.
plugin_asdk_app_6a8ebd56a408819189228d0b.longDescription:
InsightfulPipe is a marketing workspace that connects ChatGPT to the marketing, analytics, SEO, social media, and e-commerce platforms your business already uses. Ask questions in plain language, retrieve live data, create reports, and perform supported actions without manually exporting and combining spreadsheets.

Paid advertising: Connect Google Ads, Meta Ads, Microsoft Ads, LinkedIn Ads, TikTok Ads, Pinterest Ads, Snapchat Ads, and X Ads. Analyze spend, campaign performance, conversions, and other available metrics. You can also conduct competitor research using supported public advertising libraries.

SEO and site health: Access Google Search Console, Bing Webmaster Tools, and DataForSEO for search performance, SERPs, keyword rankings, and backlinks. Additional tools include website crawling, PageSpeed Insights, and Google Tag Manager.

Analytics: Retrieve insights from Google Analytics 4, Microsoft Clarity, CallRail, and YouTube Analytics.

Social media and scheduling: Analyze connected Instagram accounts, Facebook Pages, LinkedIn Pages and profiles, TikTok, Pinterest, YouTube, Google Business Profile, and WordPress. Supported connections can also schedule, publish, and reschedule content across Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok, Pinterest, YouTube, Threads, and Google Business Profile.

E-commerce and email: Connect Shopify, WooCommerce, Magento, Google Merchant Center, Klaviyo, and Mailchimp.

InsightfulPipe can combine information from normally separate platforms. For example, ask ChatGPT to compare advertising spend with website sessions, conversions, orders, and revenue across your authorized accounts.

You can also connect your own data sources, including BigQuery, PostgreSQL, MySQL, and SQL Server, with per-connection read-only or full-access permissions. Other supported sources include Airtable, Notion, Google Sheets, and Slack. Custom REST APIs can be connected using supported OpenAPI 3.x specifications.

Read and write capabilities are exposed separately. Read-only tools do not modify connected accounts, while write actions require the necessary permissions and user confirmation. All tools operate within the access granted through each connection.

An InsightfulPipe account with at least one authorized connection is required. Available platforms, data, and actions depend on the services connected by each user and the permissions they grant.
plugin_asdk_app_6a8ebd56a408819189228d0b.longDescriptionZh:
InsightfulPipe 是一个营销工作区，可将 ChatGPT 连接到您的企业已使用的营销、分析、SEO、社交媒体和电子商务平台。用简单的语言提出问题、检索实时数据、创建报告并执行支持的操作，而无需手动导出和合并电子表格。

付费广告：Connect Google Ads、Meta Ads、Microsoft Ads、LinkedIn Ads、TikTok Ads、Pinterest Ads、Snapchat Ads 和 X Ads。分析支出、活动效果、转化和其他可用指标。您还可以使用受支持的公共广告库进行竞争对手研究。

SEO 和网站健康状况：访问 Google Search Console、Bing 网站站长工具和 DataForSEO，了解搜索性能、SERP、关键字排名和反向链接。其他工具包括网站抓取、PageSpeed Insights 和 Google 跟踪代码管理器。

分析：从 Google Analytics 4、Microsoft Clarity、CallRail 和 YouTube Analytics 检索见解。

社交媒体和日程安排：分析连接的 Instagram 帐户、Facebook 页面、LinkedIn 页面和个人资料、TikTok、Pinterest、YouTube、Google Business Profile 和 WordPress。支持的连接还可以跨 Instagram、Facebook、LinkedIn、TikTok、Pinterest、YouTube、Threads 和 Google Business Profile 安排、发布和重新安排内容。

电子商务和电子邮件：Connect Shopify、WooCommerce、Magento、Google Merchant Center、Klaviyo 和 Mailchimp。

InsightfulPipe 可以合并来自通常独立平台的信息。例如，要求 ChatGPT 将授权帐户的广告支出与网站会话、转化、订单和收入进行比较。

您还可以连接自己的数据源，包括 BigQuery、PostgreSQL、MySQL 和 SQL Server，并具有每个连接的只读或完全访问权限。其他支持的来源包括 Airtable、Notion、Google Sheets 和 Slack。可以使用支持的 OpenAPI 3.x 规范连接自定义 REST API。

读取和写入功能是分开公开的。只读工具不会修改连接的帐户，而写入操作需要必要的权限和用户确认。所有工具都在通过每个连接授予的访问权限内运行。
需要具有至少一个授权连接的 InsightfulPipe 帐户。可用的平台、数据和操作取决于每个用户连接的服务及其授予的权限。
defaultPrompts: Analyze performance across my connected marketing and analytics accounts.
Compare ad spend, website traffic, conversions, and revenue across my connected sources.
Create a performance report from my connected data and save it to Google Sheets.
defaultPromptsZh: 分析我的关联营销和分析帐户的绩效。
比较我的互联来源的广告支出、网站流量、转化率和收入。
根据我的连接数据创建绩效报告并将其保存到 Google 表格。

plugin_asdk_app_69a87595e18c81919121d76e.productIntroEn: Use the PolicyNote app to access structured policy and regulatory intelligence from around the world. Search legislation, regulatory actions, policy updates, and government activity across jurisdictions.
plugin_asdk_app_69a87595e18c81919121d76e.longDescription:
Use the PolicyNote app to access structured policy and regulatory intelligence from around the world. Search legislation, regulatory actions, policy updates, and government activity across jurisdictions.

plugin_asdk_app_6a5610d5d034819186cb063a.name: Dataslayer
plugin_asdk_app_6a5610d5d034819186cb063a.productIntro: 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的 Dataslayer 帐户中可用的营销和分析数据。使用已连接到 Dataslayer 的帐户，以自然语言提出问题并从 Google Ads、Meta Ads、Google Analytics 4、LinkedIn Ads、TikTok Ads、Microsoft Advertising、Amazon Ads、Shopify、HubSpot 等平台检索数据。
plugin_asdk_app_6a5610d5d034819186cb063a.productIntroEn: Connect ChatGPT to the marketing and analytics data available in your Dataslayer account. Ask questions in natural language and retrieve data from platforms such as Google Ads, Meta Ads, Google Analytics 4, LinkedIn Ads, TikTok Ads, Microsoft Advertising, Amazon Ads, Shopify, HubSpot, and more, using the accounts already connected to Dataslayer.
plugin_asdk_app_6a5610d5d034819186cb063a.longDescription:
Connect ChatGPT to the marketing and analytics data available in your Dataslayer account. Ask questions in natural language and retrieve data from platforms such as Google Ads, Meta Ads, Google Analytics 4, LinkedIn Ads, TikTok Ads, Microsoft Advertising, Amazon Ads, Shopify, HubSpot, and more, using the accounts already connected to Dataslayer.

With the Dataslayer plugin, you can:

- Discover your available data sources and connected accounts
- Find the metrics and dimensions supported by each platform
- Retrieve campaign and performance data for specific accounts and date ranges
- Compare results across campaigns, accounts, and reporting periods
- Analyze trends and changes in your marketing performance
- Turn retrieved data into summaries, tables, and actionable insights

Example questions include:

- “Show clicks, impressions, cost, and conversions for my Google Ads account last month.”
- “Compare campaign performance this month with the previous month.”
- “Which revenue metrics are available in Google Analytics 4?”
- “List the Meta Ads accounts connected to Dataslayer.”
- “Break down TikTok Ads performance by campaign and date.”

Dataslayer retrieves the data directly from your connected marketing platforms, while ChatGPT helps you explore, interpret, and present the results. This gives marketers, agencies, and data teams a simpler way to work with their performance data without manually building complex queries.
plugin_asdk_app_6a5610d5d034819186cb063a.longDescriptionZh:
将 ChatGPT 连接到您的 Dataslayer 帐户中可用的营销和分析数据。使用已连接到 Dataslayer 的帐户，以自然语言提出问题并从 Google Ads、Meta Ads、Google Analytics 4、LinkedIn Ads、TikTok Ads、Microsoft Advertising、Amazon Ads、Shopify、HubSpot 等平台检索数据。

使用 Dataslayer 插件，您可以：

- 发现您的可用数据源和连接的帐户
- 查找每个平台支持的指标和维度
- 检索特定帐户和日期范围的活动和绩效数据
- 比较不同活动、账户和报告期间的结果
- 分析营销绩效的趋势和变化
- 将检索到的数据转化为摘要、表格和可行的见解

示例问题包括：

- “显示我的 Google Ads 帐户上个月的点击次数、展示次数、费用和转化次数。”
- “将本月与上个月的营销活动效果进行比较。”
- “Google Analytics 4 中提供了哪些收入指标？”
- “列出连接到 Dataslayer 的元广告帐户。”
- “按活动和日期细分 TikTok 广告效果。”

Dataslayer 直接从您连接的营销平台检索数据，而 ChatGPT 则帮助您探索、解释和呈现结果。这为营销人员、机构和数据团队提供了一种更简单的方法来处理他们的绩效数据，而无需手动构建复杂的查询。
defaultPrompts: Show me the marketing and analytics data sources and accounts connected to my Dataslayer account.
Analyze clicks, impressions, cost, CPC, and conversions for one Google Ads account.
Find the campaigns with the highest spend and the biggest optimization opportunities.
defaultPromptsZh: 显示连接到我的 Dataslayer 帐户的营销和分析数据源以及帐户。
分析一个 Google Ads 帐户的点击次数、展示次数、费用、每次点击费用和转化次数。
查找支出最高且优化机会最大的广告系列。

plugin_asdk_app_6a2824334d588191b362051e.name: Windsock
plugin_asdk_app_6a2824334d588191b362051e.productIntro: Windsock 估算通用航空飞机的市场价值，并提供该估算背后的支持市场数据。输入飞机的尾号（N 号）即可获取该品牌和型号的估计当前市场价值、可比飞机以及近期价格趋势。 您可以用简单的语言提出后续问题——航空电子设备、大修后的发动机时间、损坏历史或位置如何影响价值；类似的飞机通常需要多长时间才能出售；以及更广泛的细分市场如何发展。 Windsock 还提取美国联邦航空局 (FAA) 的注册详细信息、适航指令和机场级别的信息，包括当前天气和燃油价格预测。
plugin_asdk_app_6a2824334d588191b362051e.productIntroEn: Windsock estimates the market value of general aviation aircraft and provides the supporting market data behind that estimate. Enter an aircraft's tail number (N-number) to get an estimated current market value, comparable aircraft, and recent price trends for that make and model.
plugin_asdk_app_6a2824334d588191b362051e.longDescription:
Windsock estimates the market value of general aviation aircraft and provides the supporting market data behind that estimate. Enter an aircraft's tail number (N-number) to get an estimated current market value, comparable aircraft, and recent price trends for that make and model.
You can ask follow-up questions in plain language — how avionics, engine time since overhaul, damage history, or location affect value; how long similar aircraft typically take to sell; and how the broader segment is moving. Windsock also pulls FAA registry details, airworthiness directives, and airport-level information including current weather and fuel-price forecasts.
It's built for aircraft owners, buyers, sellers, brokers, and anyone who needs a defensible read on what an aircraft is worth and how its market is behaving. Estimates are model-generated for informational purposes and are not a certified appraisal.
plugin_asdk_app_6a2824334d588191b362051e.longDescriptionZh:

您可以用简单的语言提出后续问题——航空电子设备、大修后的发动机时间、损坏历史或位置如何影响价值；类似的飞机通常需要多长时间才能出售；以及更广泛的细分市场如何发展。 Windsock 还提取美国联邦航空局 (FAA) 的注册详细信息、适航指令和机场级别的信息，包括当前天气和燃油价格预测。
它是为飞机所有者、买家、卖家、经纪人以及任何需要对飞机的价值及其市场表现进行合理解读的人而设计的。估算值是模型生成的，仅供参考，并非经过认证的评估。

Evidence is an AI-powered BI tool for publishing reports using SQL and Markdown. This connector lets ChatGPT work with your organization's live data and published reports on your behalf - securely, and scoped to your own permissions.

- Browse table metadata
- Run read-only queries against data stored in Evidence
- Search your published reports by topic, metric, or term, and read a page's content or a structured summary of its queries and components
- Retrieve AI context stored in Evidence - so answers match how your organization reports

plugin_asdk_app_69e0ace8682481919ed9bce7.name: Quanti IA
plugin_asdk_app_69e0ace8682481919ed9bce7.productIntro: Quanti Analytics 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的营销数据仓库（BigQuery、Snowflake、Redshift），让您可以通过自然语言即时访问跨渠道广告数据。
plugin_asdk_app_69e0ace8682481919ed9bce7.productIntroEn: Quanti Analytics connects ChatGPT to your marketing data warehouse (BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift), giving you instant access to cross-channel advertising data through natural language.
plugin_asdk_app_69e0ace8682481919ed9bce7.longDescription:
Quanti Analytics connects ChatGPT to your marketing data warehouse (BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift), giving you instant access to cross-channel advertising data through natural language.

What you can do:

Ask questions about your marketing performance and get SQL queries generated from your actual table schemas — no hallucinated column names
Run read-only queries across 200+ connectors: Google Ads, Meta, TikTok, Amazon Ads, Microsoft Ads, Shopify, Piano Analytics, and many more
Browse pre-built report catalogs to discover available metrics and dimensions for each connector
Save useful analyses as reusable templates, personal or shared with your team
Run Marketing Mix Modeling studies to measure each channel's real contribution to your KPI
How it works:

Connect your Quanti account via OAuth
ChatGPT retrieves your project's actual data schema — including semantic definitions of every metric and dimension
Ask your question in plain language, get accurate SQL, review it, and execute
Data access is strictly read-only. Quanti never modifies your data warehouse. Only projects and datasets you have permission to access are available.
plugin_asdk_app_69e0ace8682481919ed9bce7.longDescriptionZh:
Quanti Analytics 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的营销数据仓库（BigQuery、Snowflake、Redshift），让您可以通过自然语言即时访问跨渠道广告数据。

你可以做什么：

询问有关您的营销绩效的问题，并获取从您的实际表模式生成的 SQL 查询 - 没有幻觉的列名称
跨 200 多个连接器运行只读查询：Google Ads、Meta、TikTok、Amazon Ads、Microsoft Ads、Shopify、Piano Analytics 等等
浏览预构建的报告目录以发现每个连接器的可用指标和维度
将有用的分析保存为可重复使用的模板，供个人使用或与您的团队共享
运行营销组合建模研究来衡量每个渠道对您的 KPI 的实际贡献
工作原理：

通过 OAuth 连接您的 Quanti 帐户
ChatGPT 检索项目的实际数据模式 - 包括每个指标和维度的语义定义
用简单的语言提出您的问题，获取准确的 SQL，对其进行审查并执行
数据访问严格是只读的。 Quanti 永远不会修改您的数据仓库。仅您有权访问的项目和数据集可用。

plugin_asdk_app_6a73741a42848191a5983826.productIntro: Webless 将 ChatGPT 和 Codex 连接到经过身份验证的 Webless 分析工作区。询问网站搜索需求、内容参与度、访问者旅程、获取来源和意图差距。该插件读取当前的分析目录，运行租户范围的语义查询，并可以在网络隔离的沙箱中计算比较或可视化。它不接受原始 SQL 或允许用户选择其他租户的数据。

Powered by PassBy’s proprietary data, it lets users ask simple questions like which stores are the busiest, how many people visited a location, or how performance compares across cities and brands. Answers are delivered instantly, without dashboards or analyst support.

Otto powers analysis and reports with aggregated, privacy-safe retail data to help users understand what’s happening in physical retail.

plugin_asdk_app_6a63863d58c081918f626f59.productIntro: Homesage.ai 将 ChatGPT 转变为房地产分析师，提供超过 1.55 亿套美国住宅物业的投资者级数据。连接一次，然后用简单的语言询问估价、可比销售额、租金和翻转回报、装修成本、业主详细信息和完整的房产报告。没有电子表格或手动数据提取。
plugin_asdk_app_6a63863d58c081918f626f59.productIntroEn: Homesage.ai turns ChatGPT into a real estate analyst with investor-grade data on 155M+ US residential properties. Connect once, then ask in plain language for valuations, comparable sales, rental and flip returns, renovation costs, owner details, and Full Property Reports. No spreadsheets or manual data pulls.
plugin_asdk_app_6a63863d58c081918f626f59.longDescription:
Homesage.ai turns ChatGPT into a real estate analyst with investor-grade data on 155M+ US residential properties. Connect once, then ask in plain language for valuations, comparable sales, rental and flip returns, renovation costs, owner details, and Full Property Reports. No spreadsheets or manual data pulls.

Ask about any US residential address and get property investment metrics, an automated valuation (AVM), comparable sales with after-repair value (ARV), and an AI-assessed property condition, including analysis of listing photos or your own images. The Price Flexibility Score, a Homesage.ai signature signal, predicts how negotiable a seller really is.

For investors, Homesage.ai projects fix-and-flip returns, renovation costs with room-by-room breakdowns, and both long-term and short-term rental economics such as cash flow, cap rate, NOI, and cash-on-cash return.

Screen entire markets with ZIP-level sold data and Market Outlook scores, or search the national property database with investor filters for price, condition, equity, distress signals, and more.

Additional tools cover solar potential and AI roof analysis, mortgage and lien records, pre-foreclosure status, location risk flags, and owner skip-tracing for outreach.

Most analytics tools consume credits from your Homesage.ai account, and each tool's credit cost is listed in its description. The property database search always previews the result count and cost for free before charging.

Homesage.ai reads property data and returns analysis. It does not modify your account, move funds, or take actions on your behalf. Coverage is US residential properties only, and comparable-sale and ARV data is limited in non-disclosure states where sale prices aren't public.
plugin_asdk_app_6a63863d58c081918f626f59.longDescriptionZh:
Homesage.ai 将 ChatGPT 转变为房地产分析师，提供超过 1.55 亿套美国住宅物业的投资者级数据。连接一次，然后用简单的语言询问估价、可比销售额、租金和翻转回报、装修成本、业主详细信息和完整的房产报告。没有电子表格或手动数据提取。

询问任何美国住宅地址并获取房产投资指标、自动估值 (AVM)、可比销售额与修复后价值 (ARV) 以及人工智能评估的房产状况，包括对挂牌照片或您自己的图像的分析。价格灵活性得分是 Homesage.ai 的标志性信号，可以预测卖家的谈判能力。

对于投资者来说，Homesage.ai 可以预测固定和翻转回报、按房间细分的装修成本，以及长期和短期租赁经济学，例如现金流、资本化率、NOI 和现金回报。

使用 ZIP 级别的销售数据和市场前景评分筛选整个市场，或使用投资者过滤器搜索国家房地产数据库的价格、状况、股本、遇险信号等。

其他工具包括太阳能潜力和人工智能屋顶分析、抵押和留置权记录、止赎前状态、位置风险标记以及业主跳过追踪外展。

plugin_asdk_app_6a7f1d4e9f388191ab1e0f00.longDescription:

plugin_asdk_app_6a5e636eabcc8191b0554901.productIntro: **潜台词是为代理而不是人类构建的会话重放。**
plugin_asdk_app_6a5e636eabcc8191b0554901.productIntroEn: **Subtext is session replay built for agents instead of humans.**
plugin_asdk_app_6a5e636eabcc8191b0554901.longDescription:
**Subtext is session replay built for agents instead of humans.**

Connect Subtext, and your Codex agents can open real production sessions and investigate them directly—no scrubbing a timeline, no video to watch.

Hand your agent a Subtext link from wherever it already connects—a Sentry issue, a Linear ticket, a support thread, a PR—and it uses Agentic Session Review to jump to the right moment, inspect screenshots and accessibility trees, diff DOM state, and read console and network activity to find the root cause. Then it files the fix or hands you the finding. You review the answer, not the replay.

What your agent gets:
* **Session tools it calls directly**: open a session, jump to a moment, inspect and compare state—purpose-built so agents traverse dense session data efficiently, with fewer tokens than pointing a general agent at raw replay.
* **Best-in-class capture from Fullstory**: Fullcapture behavior, pixel-perfect screenshots on demand, DOM diffs, and windowed console and network context.
* **Privacy built for production**: precision tools for agents to mask or exclude sensitive fields, plus agent-friendly DLP scanning tools over MCP.
* **Cost-effective**: Capture every session without sampling and never miss a critical user experience or bug report. Agents review the ones that matter most.

Works with Codex or any MCP-compatible agent. Code-first install, self-serve signup, generous free tier, usage-based pricing. Bring your own agent harness—Subtext is the session context it was missing.
plugin_asdk_app_6a5e636eabcc8191b0554901.longDescriptionZh:
**潜台词是为代理而不是人类构建的会话重放。**

连接 Subtext，您的 Codex 代理可以打开真实的制作会话并直接调查它们 - 无需清理时间线，也无需观看视频。

从已经连接的任何地方（Sentry 问题、线性票证、支持线程、PR）向您的代理提供 Subtext 链接，它使用 Agentic Session Review 跳转到正确的时刻，检查屏幕截图和可访问性树，比较 DOM 状态，并读取控制台和网络活动以查找根本原因。然后它会提交修复程序或将结果交给您。您查看答案，而不是重播。

您的代理人会得到什么：
* **它直接调用的会话工具**：打开会话，跳转到某个时刻，检查和比较状态 - 专门构建的，因此代理可以有效地遍历密集的会话数据，比在原始重放中指向通用代理所需的令牌更少。
* **来自 Fullstory 的一流捕获**：完整捕获行为、按需完美像素屏幕截图、DOM 差异以及窗口控制台和网络上下文。
* **为生产而构建的隐私**：供代理屏蔽或排除敏感字段的精密工具，以及基于 MCP 的代理友好型 DLP 扫描工具。
* **经济高效**：无需采样即可捕获每个会话，并且绝不会错过关键的用户体验或错误报告。代理会审查最重要的内容。

可与 Codex 或任何 MCP 兼容代理配合使用。代码优先安装、自助注册、慷慨的免费套餐、基于使用的定价。带上您自己的代理工具 - Subtext 是它缺少的会话上下文。

plugin_asdk_app_6a54bd377acc8191ab61241c.productIntro: pokeka 是分级神奇宝贝交易卡的市场参考。用简单的语言询问——甚至是像“Moonbreon”这样的收藏家昵称——并获得准确的卡标识（卡组和编号）、具有日期、30/90 天趋势和稀缺信号的代表性市场价值。它涵盖日语、英语和简体中文卡，每种语言都有单独的市场数据轨道。数据来自经过验证的拍卖结果并不断刷新。
plugin_asdk_app_6a54bd377acc8191ab61241c.productIntroEn: pokeka is a market reference for graded Pokémon trading cards. Ask in plain language — even collector nicknames like "Moonbreon" — and get the exact card identity (set and number), a representative market value with date, 30/90-day trend, and scarcity signals. It covers Japanese, English, and Simplified-Chinese cards with a separate market-data track for each language.
plugin_asdk_app_6a54bd377acc8191ab61241c.longDescription: pokeka is a market reference for graded Pokémon trading cards. It covers Japanese, English, and Simplified-Chinese cards with a separate market-data track for each language. Data comes from verified auction results and is refreshed continuously.

plugin_asdk_app_6a5c0b47f55c8191a0dd3096.name: Sleekplan
plugin_asdk_app_6a5c0b47f55c8191a0dd3096.productIntro: 直接从 ChatGPT 使用您的 Sleekplan 工作区 - 反馈板、路线图、变更日志和调查。
plugin_asdk_app_6a5c0b47f55c8191a0dd3096.productIntroEn: Work with your Sleekplan workspace — feedback board, roadmap, changelog, and surveys — directly from ChatGPT.
plugin_asdk_app_6a5c0b47f55c8191a0dd3096.longDescription:
Work with your Sleekplan workspace — feedback board, roadmap, changelog, and surveys — directly from ChatGPT.

Ask for a summary of your top feature requests and see what customers are actually asking for, ranked by votes and recent activity. Find duplicate posts and merge them so votes count toward a single request. Update statuses, assign tags, and reply to customers with comments. When you ship something, draft and publish a changelog entry without leaving the conversation. Review NPS, CSAT, and survey responses to understand how users feel about your product.

The plugin covers 40+ actions across feedback posts, votes and voters, comments, tags, statuses, users and segments, surveys, and changelog entries. Reads run instantly; anything that changes data — creating, editing, merging, deleting — is shown to you and confirmed before it runs.

Requires a Sleekplan workspace with admin or contributor access. Sign in with your Sleekplan account when connecting.
plugin_asdk_app_6a5c0b47f55c8191a0dd3096.longDescriptionZh:
直接从 ChatGPT 使用您的 Sleekplan 工作区 - 反馈板、路线图、变更日志和调查。

询问您最重要的功能请求的摘要，并查看客户实际要求的内容（按投票和最近活动排名）。查找重复的帖子并将其合并，以便投票计入单个请求。更新状态、分配标签并回复客户评论。当您发布某些内容时，无需离开对话即可起草并发布变更日志条目。查看 NPS、CSAT 和调查回复，了解用户对您的产品的感受。

该插件涵盖反馈帖子、投票和选民、评论、标签、状态、用户和细分、调查和变更日志条目等 40 多个操作。读取立即运行；任何更改数据的操作（创建、编辑、合并、删除）都会在运行之前向您显示并确认。

需要具有管理员或贡献者访问权限的 Sleekplan 工作区。连接时使用您的 Sleekplan 帐户登录。

turn my commit notes into a changelog draft

plugin_asdk_app_69f2c16423b081919ad4d135.productIntro: Jepto 连接到您的营销堆栈，让人工智能在您的整个客户组合中发挥作用，这样您就可以花更少的时间提取报告，而有更多的时间做出重要的决策。
plugin_asdk_app_69f2c16423b081919ad4d135.productIntroEn: Jepto connects to your marketing stack and puts AI to work across your entire client portfolio, so you spend less time pulling reports and more time making decisions that matter.
plugin_asdk_app_69f2c16423b081919ad4d135.longDescription:
Jepto connects to your marketing stack and puts AI to work across your entire client portfolio, so you spend less time pulling reports and more time making decisions that matter.

Pull in data from Google Ads, Meta, GA4, Google Search Console, Google Business Profile, and 20+ other channels into one place. From there, Jepto's AI helps you chat with your data in plain language, automatically generate client-ready reports, track ad budgets with campaign-level granularity, and catch anomalies before they become problems — no manual dashboard-checking required.

Ask questions about campaign performance across any connected client
- Check budget pacing and flag overspend risks
- Surface anomalies and insights from your marketing data
- Trigger actions like pausing campaigns or updating budgets — with your approval
- Pull KPI forecasts powered by machine learning

It's built for digital marketing agencies managing multiple clients, but works just as well for in-house teams who want a smarter, faster way to stay on top of their data.
plugin_asdk_app_69f2c16423b081919ad4d135.longDescriptionZh:
Jepto 连接到您的营销堆栈，让人工智能在您的整个客户组合中发挥作用，这样您就可以花更少的时间提取报告，而有更多的时间做出重要的决策。

将 Google Ads、Meta、GA4、Google Search Console、Google 商家资料和 20 多个其他渠道的数据提取到一处。从那里，Jepto 的 AI 可以帮助您以简单的语言与数据对话，自动生成客户就绪的报告，以广告系列级别的粒度跟踪广告预算，并在异常出现之前捕获它们 - 无需手动仪表板检查。

询问有关任何已连接客户端的营销活动绩效的问题
- 检查预算进度并标记超支风险
- 从营销数据中发现异常现象和见解
- 在您的批准下触发暂停营销活动或更新预算等操作
- 由机器学习驱动的 KPI 预测

它专为管理多个客户的数字营销机构而构建，但也适用于希望以更智能、更快速的方式掌握数据的内部团队。

defaultPromptsZh: 跟踪 Cool Air 的广告支出以达到 2,000 美元的目标

Connect ChatGPT to Alation’s enterprise data catalog, governance, and trusted business context so users can discover, understand, and use data with confidence.

plugin_asdk_app_6a6a0f6c3d2c8191a795d56b.name: Alizé
plugin_asdk_app_6a6a0f6c3d2c8191a795d56b.productIntro: Alizé 是一个面向法律专业人士的法律数据库和搜索引擎。通过此连接器，您的助手可以根据真实文档而不是凭记忆进行回答，并为您提供可以打开和检查的引文。
plugin_asdk_app_6a6a0f6c3d2c8191a795d56b.productIntroEn: Alizé is a legal database and search engine for law professionals. With this connector, your assistant answers from the real documents instead of from memory, and gives you a citation you can open and check.
plugin_asdk_app_6a6a0f6c3d2c8191a795d56b.longDescription:
Alizé is a legal database and search engine for law professionals. With this connector, your assistant answers from the real documents instead of from memory, and gives you a citation you can open and check.

It searches the same corpus the Alizé platform runs on: more than 20 million documents across some 250 collections, ingested from the official publishers and updated daily. Coverage is fully developed for Luxembourg, Belgium, Spain and the European Union, alongside partial coverage of France and international law. Collections are complete rather than sampled, consolidated rather than scattered, and tracked for in-force status document by document.

Your assistant does the thinking. Alizé gives it the real law to think on.

You need an Alizé account and your firm's existing subscription. You reach the same collections you already have in Alizé, and nothing more. The connector reaches Alizé's legal databases only, so it never sees your own files.
plugin_asdk_app_6a6a0f6c3d2c8191a795d56b.longDescriptionZh:
Alizé 是一个面向法律专业人士的法律数据库和搜索引擎。通过此连接器，您的助手可以根据真实文档而不是凭记忆进行回答，并为您提供可以打开和检查的引文。

它搜索与 Alizé 平台运行的同一语料库：约 250 个馆藏中的超过 2000 万份文档，从官方出版商处获取并每日更新。全面覆盖卢森堡、比利时、西班牙和欧盟，同时部分覆盖法国和国际法。收集是完整的而不是抽样的，是合并的而不是分散的，并且逐个文档地跟踪有效状态。

你的助手负责思考。艾莉婕赋予它真正的法则来思考。

您需要一个 Alizé 帐户和您公司的现有订阅。您所获得的收藏与 Alizé 中已有的收藏相同，仅此而已。连接器仅到达 Alizé 的合法数据库，因此它永远不会看到您自己的文件。

比利时。 BV/SRL 的董事是否可以无正当理由被免职？参考来源。没有网络搜索。

plugin_asdk_app_6a5259b0384881919be9cb31.productIntro: 将 ChatGPT 连接到 Damoov 远程信息处理数据，并将操作问题转化为清晰、可操作的见解。
plugin_asdk_app_6a5259b0384881919be9cb31.productIntroEn: Connect ChatGPT to Damoov telematics data and turn operational questions into clear, actionable insights.
plugin_asdk_app_6a5259b0384881919be9cb31.longDescription:
Connect ChatGPT to Damoov telematics data and turn operational questions into clear, actionable insights.

The Damoov MCP server lets authorized users explore company-level mobility metrics, including trip counts, distance, active drivers, safety scores, and harsh driving events. Analyze trends over custom periods, compare performance between time ranges, break metrics down by day or driver, and identify top contributors—all through natural-language requests.

Designed for fleet, insurance, mobility, logistics, and driving-safety use cases, it provides secure access only to the Damoov companies and data available to the authenticated user.
plugin_asdk_app_6a5259b0384881919be9cb31.longDescriptionZh:
将 ChatGPT 连接到 Damoov 远程信息处理数据，并将操作问题转化为清晰、可操作的见解。

Damoov MCP 服务器允许授权用户探索公司级移动指标，包括行程计数、距离、活跃驾驶员、安全评分和恶劣驾驶事件。分析自定义时间段内的趋势，比较时间范围之间的性能，按天或驱动因素细分指标，并确定主要贡献者——所有这些都通过自然语言请求进行。

它专为车队、保险、移动、物流和驾驶安全用例而设计，仅提供对 Damoov 公司的安全访问以及经过身份验证的用户可用的数据。

plugin_asdk_app_6a57223c7e648191b790ff2f.name: PowerDMARC
plugin_asdk_app_6a57223c7e648191b790ff2f.productIntro: PowerDMARC 将您的电子邮件身份验证数据带入 ChatGPT。询问任何域的安全状况并获得解释的 DMARC、SPF、DKIM、BIMI 和 MTA-STS 细分。深入研究 DMARC 汇总报告，了解谁在作为您的域发送电子邮件、哪些来源未通过身份验证，以及按国家/地区和组织列出您的邮件来自何处。
plugin_asdk_app_6a57223c7e648191b790ff2f.productIntroEn: PowerDMARC brings your email-authentication data into ChatGPT. Ask about any domain's security posture and get an interpreted DMARC, SPF, DKIM, BIMI, and MTA-STS breakdown. Dig into DMARC aggregate reports to see who's sending email as your domain, which sources are failing authentication, and where your mail is coming from by country and organization.
plugin_asdk_app_6a57223c7e648191b790ff2f.longDescription:
PowerDMARC brings your email-authentication data into ChatGPT. Ask about any domain's security posture and get an interpreted DMARC, SPF, DKIM, BIMI, and MTA-STS breakdown. Dig into DMARC aggregate reports to see who's sending email as your domain, which sources are failing authentication, and where your mail is coming from by country and organization.

Look up live DNS and WHOIS records, generate correctly-formatted DMARC, SPF, and DKIM records, and review your hosted-service configuration.

Authentication is handled securely via OAuth — the plugin accesses only what your PowerDMARC account already permits, and never stores your credentials or tokens.
plugin_asdk_app_6a57223c7e648191b790ff2f.longDescriptionZh:
PowerDMARC 将您的电子邮件身份验证数据带入 ChatGPT。询问任何域的安全状况并获得解释的 DMARC、SPF、DKIM、BIMI 和 MTA-STS 细分。深入研究 DMARC 汇总报告，了解谁在作为您的域发送电子邮件、哪些来源未通过身份验证，以及按国家/地区和组织列出您的邮件来自何处。

查找实时 DNS 和 WHOIS 记录，生成格式正确的 DMARC、SPF 和 DKIM 记录，并检查您的托管服务配置。

身份验证通过 OAuth 安全处理 - 该插件仅访问您的 PowerDMARC 帐户已允许的内容，并且从不存储您的凭据或令牌。

Show me who's sending email as my domain and which sources are failing
Generate a DMARC record with a reject policy
defaultPromptsZh: 检查我的域的电子邮件身份验证运行状况
显示谁作为我的域发送电子邮件以及哪些来源出现故障
生成具有拒绝策略的 DMARC 记录

plugin_asdk_app_6a888e2ed7288191b4a7a578.description: 跟踪 AI 可见性、AEO 和 GEO
plugin_asdk_app_6a888e2ed7288191b4a7a578.productIntro: Finseo 跟踪您的品牌在人工智能搜索中的可见度——人们从 ChatGPT、Perplexity、Gemini、Claude 和其他人工智能助手获得的答案。它将您的 AI 可见性、生成引擎优化 (GEO) 和答案引擎优化 (AEO) 数据直接引入 ChatGPT。
plugin_asdk_app_6a888e2ed7288191b4a7a578.productIntroEn: Finseo tracks how visible your brand is in AI search — the answers people get from ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude and other AI assistants. It brings your AI visibility, generative engine optimization (GEO) and answer engine optimization (AEO) data directly into ChatGPT.
plugin_asdk_app_6a888e2ed7288191b4a7a578.longDescription:
Finseo tracks how visible your brand is in AI search — the answers people get from ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude and other AI assistants. It brings your AI visibility, generative engine optimization (GEO) and answer engine optimization (AEO) data directly into ChatGPT.

Connect your Finseo account and ask questions like:
- "How visible is my brand in AI search this month?"
- "Which competitors are mentioned more often in AI answers?"
- "Which sources do AI models cite in my industry?"
- "Show me the tracked prompts where my brand doesn't appear yet."

What you can do:
- AI visibility KPIs: visibility rate, share of voice, average mention order and mention depth, with trends over custom date ranges
- Competitor tracking: AI visibility rankings, gap analysis and head-to-head comparisons
- Prompt-level insights: inspect tracked prompts and the actual AI answers, including brand sentiment
- Citation analysis: see which domains AI assistants cite and how often your content appears as a source
- GEO recommendations: review AI-generated optimization tasks to improve your visibility in AI search

The plugin is read-only: it retrieves your tracking data but never modifies it. Requires a Finseo account (finseo.ai).
plugin_asdk_app_6a888e2ed7288191b4a7a578.longDescriptionZh:
Finseo 跟踪您的品牌在人工智能搜索中的可见度——人们从 ChatGPT、Perplexity、Gemini、Claude 和其他人工智能助手获得的答案。它将您的 AI 可见性、生成引擎优化 (GEO) 和答案引擎优化 (AEO) 数据直接引入 ChatGPT。

连接您的 Finseo 帐户并提出以下问题：
- “本月我的品牌在人工智能搜索中的可见度如何？”
- “人工智能答案中更常提到哪些竞争对手？”
- “人工智能模型在我的行业中引用了哪些来源？”
- “显示我的品牌尚未出现的跟踪提示。”

你可以做什么：
- AI 可见度 KPI：可见度、声音份额、平均提及顺序和提及深度，以及自定义日期范围内的趋势
- 竞争对手跟踪：AI可见度排名、差距分析和头对头比较
- 提示级洞察：检查跟踪的提示和实际的人工智能答案，包括品牌情感
- 引文分析：查看人工智能助手引用了哪些领域以及您的内容作为来源出现的频率
- GEO 建议：查看 AI 生成的优化任务，以提高您在 AI 搜索中的可见性

该插件是只读的：它检索您的跟踪数据但从不修改它。需要 Finseo 帐户 (finseo.ai)。
defaultPrompts: How visible is my brand in AI search right now?
Which competitors are mentioned more often than my brand in AI answers?
Which sources do AI models cite in my industry, and how can I improve my AI visibility?
defaultPromptsZh: 目前我的品牌在人工智能搜索中的可见度如何？
在 AI 答案中，哪些竞争对手比我的品牌更常被提及？

plugin_asdk_app_6a91a85bf4a08191af8367df.name: Keenable SELECT
plugin_asdk_app_6a91a85bf4a08191af8367df.description: 使用 SQL 研究网络
plugin_asdk_app_6a91a85bf4a08191af8367df.productIntro: Keenable SELECT 通过一次查询而不是十页读取来回答研究问题。
plugin_asdk_app_6a91a85bf4a08191af8367df.productIntroEn: Keenable SELECT answers a research question with one query instead of ten page reads.
plugin_asdk_app_6a91a85bf4a08191af8367df.longDescription:
Keenable SELECT answers a research question with one query instead of ten page reads.

Ordinary web search hands the model a list of links and leaves the reading, the extraction and the de-duplication to it. SELECT does that work inside the search. The model writes one read-only SQL statement in a DuckDB dialect; the server runs the searches in parallel, fetches the pages, pulls out the fields the query asks for with a per-row model call, removes duplicates, and returns a table.

One query can cover more than a thousand pages, filter them with ordinary SQL at no extra cost, and group them into the answer. The rows arrive as a table, not as a wall of page text, so the answer is grounded in a lot more sources than the context could hold.

Every result is saved as a result set for 30 days, so the next question can be asked of the same pages without searching again. A finished table can be published as a single HTML report, charts and all, at a link you can hand to someone.

Use it for a survey, a comparison or a ranking across many sources. It is not the tool for a quick look at one page: a query runs from seconds to minutes, because it really does search, fetch and read.

Connect your Keenable account once to enable it. Searching and fetching bill that account.
plugin_asdk_app_6a91a85bf4a08191af8367df.longDescriptionZh:
Keenable SELECT 通过一次查询而不是十页读取来回答研究问题。

普通的网络搜索会将链接列表交给模型，然后将读取、提取和重复数据删除交给它。 SELECT 在搜索中执行此操作。该模型以 DuckDB 方言编写一条只读 SQL 语句；服务器并行运行搜索，获取页面，通过每行模型调用提取查询要求的字段，删除重复项，然后返回一个表。

一个查询可以覆盖一千多个页面，使用普通 SQL 过滤它们，无需额外成本，并将它们分组到答案中。这些行以表格形式到达，而不是以页面文本的形式到达，因此答案基于比上下文所能容纳的更多的来源。

每个结果都会作为结果集保存 30 天，因此可以在同一页面询问下一个问题，而无需再次搜索。完成的表格可以作为单个 HTML 报告、图表等内容发布，您可以通过链接将其交给其他人。

将其用于跨多个来源的调查、比较或排名。它不是快速查看一页的工具：查询运行从几秒到几分钟，因为它确实进行搜索、获取和读取。

连接您的 Keenable 帐户一次即可启用它。搜索并获取该帐户的账单。
defaultPrompts: 1. Which countries have announced a national AI strategy, and in what month? Give me a table with a source URL per row.
2. Compare the open-source vector databases on licence, storage backend and whether they support hybrid search
Publish the table you just built as an HTML report and give me the link.
defaultPromptsZh: 1. 哪些国家宣布了国家人工智能战略？在什么月份？给我一个表，每行都有一个源 URL。
2. 比较开源矢量数据库的许可证、存储后端以及是否支持混合搜索
将您刚刚构建的表格发布为 HTML 报告并给我链接。

plugin_asdk_app_6a541c656f148191a4504fe6.productIntro: Collecte MTL 会告诉您您的废物何时在蒙特利尔岛上的任何地方被收集。输入地址并获取每个流的收集时间表 - 垃圾、回收、食品和有机废物、绿色废物和大件物品 - 包括该确切部门的下一个即将到来的收集日期。
plugin_asdk_app_6a541c656f148191a4504fe6.productIntroEn: Collecte MTL tells you when your waste is collected anywhere on the island of Montréal. Enter an address and get the pickup schedule for every stream — garbage, recycling, food and organic waste, green waste, and bulky items — including the next upcoming collection dates for that exact sector.
plugin_asdk_app_6a541c656f148191a4504fe6.longDescription:
Collecte MTL tells you when your waste is collected anywhere on the island of Montréal. Enter an address and get the pickup schedule for every stream — garbage, recycling, food and organic waste, green waste, and bulky items — including the next upcoming collection dates for that exact sector.

It can also point you to the nearest écocentres (drop-off centres) for materials that aren't picked up curbside, and show your borough's waste recovery and diversion rates.

The data comes straight from the City of Montréal's official open data (Secteurs Info-collectes), refreshed about once a month. Collecte MTL is a free, independent tool — not affiliated with the City of Montréal — and stores no personal information: an address is used only to look up its collection sector.
plugin_asdk_app_6a541c656f148191a4504fe6.longDescriptionZh:
Collecte MTL 会告诉您您的废物何时在蒙特利尔岛上的任何地方被收集。输入地址并获取每个流的收集时间表 - 垃圾、回收、食品和有机废物、绿色废物和大件物品 - 包括该确切部门的下一个即将到来的收集日期。

它还可以为您指明最近的生态中心（垃圾回收中心），以获取未在路边收集的材料，并显示您所在行政区的废物回收和转移率。

该数据直接来自蒙特利尔市的官方开放数据（Secteurs Info-collectes），大约每月刷新一次。 Collecte MTL 是一款免费、独立的工具，不隶属于蒙特利尔市，并且不存储任何个人信息：地址仅用于查找其收集部门。

plugin_asdk_app_6a91fcd93878819188347d20.name: WisdomAI
plugin_asdk_app_6a91fcd93878819188347d20.description: 来自您管理的数据的答案
plugin_asdk_app_6a91fcd93878819188347d20.productIntro: WisdomAI 是 ChatGPT 内部的企业数据工具，用于解决复杂的分析问题，其答案必须是确定性的、可追溯的和一致的。
plugin_asdk_app_6a91fcd93878819188347d20.productIntroEn: WisdomAI is the enterprise data harness inside ChatGPT, for the complex analytical questions where the answer has to be deterministic, traceable, and consistent.
plugin_asdk_app_6a91fcd93878819188347d20.longDescription:
WisdomAI is the enterprise data harness inside ChatGPT, for the complex analytical questions where the answer has to be deterministic, traceable, and consistent.

Connectors provide access. Catalogs and semantic layers provide definitions. The WisdomAI harness applies both at runtime by selecting the right context for each question, enforcing row- and column-level security for the person asking, optimizing execution for the underlying platform, verifying results, and repairing failed queries.

Business context strengthens continuously as WisdomAI learns from documents, query logs, catalogs, semantic layers, dbt, and BI metadata, proactively identifies where it lacked sufficient context, and routes proposed changes through expert review and versioning. Corrections become governed organizational knowledge rather than one-time fixes buried in individual conversations.

WisdomAI works across data platforms, sources, and deployment environments, including fully on-premises for regulated data that cannot leave your environment. The harness, the context, and query execution stay behind your firewall; only the answer crosses.

Every answer is grounded in governed definitions, enterprise data, and visible sources making it trustworthy enough to run your business on.

Use WisdomAI in ChatGPT to:
- Ask questions of governed business data: "How did Q3 net revenue track against plan in EMEA?"
- Follow up in the same line of analysis: "Break that down by segment and show the last 4 quarters"
- Investigate an open-ended question end to end: "We missed plan in EMEA last quarter. What drove it, which segments and accounts moved most, and what should we watch going into Q4?"
- Trace an answer to its definitions and sources: "Which definition of net revenue was used, and what data did it come from?"
- See what's available to you: "What data do I have access to, and which metrics are defined for finance?"
plugin_asdk_app_6a91fcd93878819188347d20.longDescriptionZh:
WisdomAI 是 ChatGPT 内部的企业数据工具，用于解决复杂的分析问题，其答案必须是确定性的、可追溯的和一致的。

连接器提供访问。目录和语义层提供定义。 WisdomAI 工具在运行时通过为每个问题选择正确的上下文、为提问者实施行级和列级安全性、优化底层平台的执行、验证结果以及修复失败的查询来应用这两种方法。

随着 WisdomAI 从文档、查询日志、目录、语义层、dbt 和 BI 元数据中学习，业务上下文不断增强，主动识别缺乏足够上下文的地方，并通过专家审查和版本控制来路由建议的更改。更正成为受管理的组织知识，而不是埋藏在个人对话中的一次性修复。

WisdomAI 跨数据平台、来源和部署环境工作，包括完全本地化的受监管数据，这些数据不能离开您的环境。线束、上下文和查询执行位于防火墙后面；只有答案交叉。

每个答案都基于受监管的定义、企业数据和可见来源，使其足够值得信赖，可以用来运行您的业务。

在 ChatGPT 中使用 WisdomAI 可以：
- 提出有关受监管业务数据的问题：“欧洲、中东和非洲地区第三季度净收入如何跟踪计划？”
- 进行同样的分析：“按细分市场细分并显示过去 4 个季度”
- 端到端调查一个开放式问题：“上个季度我们错过了欧洲、中东和非洲地区的计划。是什么推动了这一计划，哪些细分市场和客户变化最大，以及进入第四季度我们应该关注什么？”
- 追踪其定义和来源的答案：“使用了哪种净收入定义，它来自哪些数据？”
- 查看您可以使用哪些内容：“我可以访问哪些数据，以及为财务定义了哪些指标？”
defaultPrompts: How did Q3 net revenue track against plans in EMEA?
Break that down by segment and show the last four quarters.
Which definition of net revenue was used, and what data did it come from?
defaultPromptsZh: 第三季度净收入与欧洲、中东和非洲地区计划的跟踪情况如何？
按部分细分并显示过去四个季度。
使用了哪种净收入定义？它来自哪些数据？

plugin_asdk_app_6a5f821f4efc81919f8186da.productIntro: Kanal 是一个针对电商品牌的 WhatsApp 营销平台。 连接您的 Kanal 帐户，向 ChatGPT 询问有关您 WhatsApp 营销绩效的任何信息：归因收入、ROAS 和总渠道成本、活动和自动化统计数据（具体到各个流程步骤）、受众群体和规模以及元模板批准状态。
plugin_asdk_app_6a5f821f4efc81919f8186da.productIntroEn: Kanal is a WhatsApp marketing platform for e-commerce brands. Connect your Kanal account to ask ChatGPT anything about your WhatsApp marketing performance: attributed revenue, ROAS and total channel cost, campaign and automation stats down to individual flow steps, audience segments and sizes, and Meta template approval status.
plugin_asdk_app_6a5f821f4efc81919f8186da.longDescription:
Kanal is a WhatsApp marketing platform for e-commerce brands.
Connect your Kanal account to ask ChatGPT anything about your WhatsApp marketing performance: attributed revenue, ROAS and total channel cost, campaign and automation stats down to individual flow steps, audience segments and sizes, and Meta template approval status. 

All tools are read-only, and every metric uses the same attribution engine and settings as your Kanal dashboard, so the numbers always match what you see in the app. 

Example questions: 
- "What's my WhatsApp ROAS over the last 30 days?"
- "Compare my last 3 campaigns"
- "Which step of my abandoned-cart flow converts best?". 

Requires a Kanal account (Scale plan for full access, discovery quota on Pro).
plugin_asdk_app_6a5f821f4efc81919f8186da.longDescriptionZh:
Kanal 是一个针对电商品牌的 WhatsApp 营销平台。
连接您的 Kanal 帐户，向 ChatGPT 询问有关您 WhatsApp 营销绩效的任何信息：归因收入、ROAS 和总渠道成本、活动和自动化统计数据（具体到各个流程步骤）、受众群体和规模以及元模板批准状态。 

所有工具都是只读的，每个指标都使用与 Kanal 仪表板相同的归因引擎和设置，因此数字始终与您在应用程序中看到的相符。 

示例问题： 
- “过去 30 天我的 WhatsApp ROAS 是多少？”
- “比较我最近的 3 个营销活动”
- “我的废弃购物车流程的哪一步转化效果最好？”。 

需要 Kanal 帐户（完全访问的扩展计划、Pro 上的发现配额）。

plugin_asdk_app_6a6c54800a9c8191bf510c47.name: Lead Recorder
plugin_asdk_app_6a6c54800a9c8191bf510c47.originalDescription: See where every lead came from
plugin_asdk_app_6a6c54800a9c8191bf510c47.productIntro: 潜在客户记录器会向您显示潜在客户的实际来源。
plugin_asdk_app_6a6c54800a9c8191bf510c47.productIntroEn: Lead Recorder shows you where your leads actually came from.
plugin_asdk_app_6a6c54800a9c8191bf510c47.longDescription:
Lead Recorder shows you where your leads actually came from.

It tracks every phone click, form submission and enquiry on a website and matches each one back to the exact ad, Google search or post that produced it. This plugin lets you ask about that data in plain English instead of opening a dashboard.

Three read-only tools:

List Sites returns the client websites your account can report on.

Get Quiet Sites lists sites with no leads in the last few days. Useful if you manage a lot of client sites and want to catch a problem before the client does.

Get Monthly Report returns the numbers for one site in a given month: total leads, new versus returning visitors, the split between phone clicks, forms and email enquiries, the paid, organic and direct channel breakdown, top sources and campaigns, and the percentage of leads that arrived outside business hours.

Things you can ask:

"Which of my client sites had no leads this week?"
"How did Bob's Plumbing do last month and where did the leads come from?"
"Write this month's lead report for a client using the real numbers."

It's built for marketing agencies and the businesses they work with, particularly local service businesses where the enquiry is a phone call rather than an online checkout.

You'll need a Lead Recorder account with the tracking snippet installed on at least one site. There's a free plan and installation takes about thirty seconds. Nothing in your account can be modified through this plugin.
plugin_asdk_app_6a6c54800a9c8191bf510c47.longDescriptionZh:
潜在客户记录器会向您显示潜在客户的实际来源。

它跟踪网站上的每一次电话点击、表单提交和查询，并将每一次点击与生成它的确切广告、谷歌搜索或帖子进行匹配。该插件可让您以简单的英语询问该数据，而无需打开仪表板。

三个只读工具：

列出网站会返回您的帐户可以报告的客户网站。

保持安静的网站列出了过去几天没有潜在客户的网站。如果您管理大量客户站点并希望在客户发现问题之前发现问题，这非常有用。

获取月度报告返回一个网站在给定月份的数字：潜在客户总数、新访问者与回访者、电话点击次数、表格和电子邮件查询之间的比例、付费渠道、自然渠道和直接渠道细分、主要来源和营销活动，以及在工作时间之外到达的潜在客户的百分比。

您可以询问的事项：

“本周我的哪些客户网站没有线索？”
“鲍勃的管道公司上个月表现如何？线索来自哪里？”
“使用真实数据为客户撰写本月的主要报告。”

plugin_asdk_app_6a741648ade4819196fed962.name: Muffed
plugin_asdk_app_6a741648ade4819196fed962.description: 查找经过验证的 NFL 统计数据
plugin_asdk_app_6a741648ade4819196fed962.productIntro: 穆菲用已经核实过的数据回答了 NFL 的问题。每个数字都来自基于 nflverse 逐场比赛、NFL 下一代统计数据和 FTN 图表数据构建的门控面板，每个响应都带有自己的来源、验证日期以及数据许可证所需的归属。
plugin_asdk_app_6a741648ade4819196fed962.productIntroEn: Muffed answers NFL questions with figures that have already been checked. Every number comes from a gated panel built on nflverse play-by-play, NFL Next Gen Stats and FTN charting data, and every response carries its own source, the date it was verified, and the attribution the data licence requires.
plugin_asdk_app_6a741648ade4819196fed962.longDescription:
Muffed answers NFL questions with figures that have already been checked. Every number comes from a gated panel built on nflverse play-by-play, NFL Next Gen Stats and FTN charting data, and every response carries its own source, the date it was verified, and the attribution the data licence requires.

Ask what the data says is actually real in the NFL right now, look up a player's or team's season figures, pull a leaderboard, get a plain explanation of an advanced metric like EPA or CPOE, compare two players side by side, or check a statistic you saw somewhere else — Muffed will tell you the real value when it disagrees. You can also connect a Sleeper league by id to get verified context on the players in it.

Muffed publishes no projections, no start/sit or lineup advice, no draft grades, no rankings-as-advice and no picks, and carries no betting lines or odds. No tool on this server can produce one: there is no projection model behind it and no ranking-as-advice surface.

Every response marks its own boundary. A citation names exactly which figures it covers and states that it does not extend to analysis derived from them. Figures computed on request rather than drawn from the pre-verified panel are labelled `computed_not_verified` and carry the executed method and population size. Where Muffed holds nothing for a request, it says so explicitly, states the coverage it does have, and declines attribution for whatever fills the gap. An assistant calling this server may add commentary, comparison or recommendation of its own on top of the returned figures; that commentary is the assistant's and is outside what Muffed verifies or attributes.

Free, read-only, no account required. Fantasy scoring figures use half-PPR, the most common single redraft default, and say so wherever they appear.
plugin_asdk_app_6a741648ade4819196fed962.longDescriptionZh:
穆菲用已经核实过的数据回答了 NFL 的问题。每个数字都来自基于 nflverse 逐场比赛、NFL 下一代统计数据和 FTN 图表数据构建的门控面板，每个响应都带有自己的来源、验证日期以及数据许可证所需的归属。

询问目前 NFL 中的数据是否真实，查找球员或球队的赛季数据，拉出排行榜，获得 EPA 或 CPOE 等高级指标的简单解释，并排比较两名球员，或者检查您在其他地方看到的统计数据 - Muffed 会在不一致时告诉您真实值。您还可以通过 ID 连接卧铺联赛，以获取其中球员的经过验证的背景信息。

Muffed 不发布任何预测、不提供首发/上场或阵容建议、不提供选秀成绩、不提供排名建议、不提供选秀权，也不提供投注线或赔率。该服务器上的任何工具都无法生成这样的结果：其背后没有投影模型，也没有排名即建议的界面。

每一个回应都标志着它自己的边界。引文准确地指出了它所涵盖的数字，并声明它不延伸到从这些数字得出的分析。根据请求计算而不是从预先验证的面板中绘制的数字被标记为“compulated_not_verified”，并带有执行的方法和人口规模。如果 Muffed 没有任何要求，它会如此明确地说明，说明其确实拥有的覆盖范围，并拒绝归因于任何填补空白的内容。调用该服务器的助手可以在返回的数据之上添加自己的评论、比较或推荐；该评论是助理的，超出了 Muffed 验证或属性的范围。

免费、只读、无需帐户。幻想评分数字使用半 PPR，这是最常见的单一重新起草默认值，并且无论它们出现在哪里，都会这么说。

plugin_asdk_app_6a8c7c22d4188191b3619be5.productIntro: 更智能的数据，更大的影响力，就在您的人工智能工作流程中。 Impala 的连接器为您提供有关任何美国非营利组织或基金会的即时组织和资助者信息，这些信息是从包含超过 200 万个非营利组织、超过 25 万个资助者以及基于经过验证的注册机构、政府数据库和直接合作伙伴建立的超过 2500 万笔赠款的数据库中实时提取的。
plugin_asdk_app_6a8c7c22d4188191b3619be5.productIntroEn: Smarter data, greater impact, right inside your AI workflow. Impala's connector gives you instant organization and funder intel on any U.S. nonprofit or foundation, drawn live from a database of 2M+ nonprofits, 250K+ grantmakers, and 25M+ grants built from verified registries, government databases, and direct partnerships.
plugin_asdk_app_6a8c7c22d4188191b3619be5.longDescription:
Smarter data, greater impact, right inside your AI workflow. Impala's connector gives you instant organization and funder intel on any U.S. nonprofit or foundation, drawn live from a database of 2M+ nonprofits, 250K+ grantmakers, and 25M+ grants built from verified registries, government databases, and direct partnerships.

Built for the teams that power philanthropy: grants management, programs, development, funder networks, and advisors. Ask it to:

- Research any nonprofit or foundation: mission, programs, leadership, board, and how to apply
- Check financial health with Form 990 income statements, balance sheets, key ratios, and multi-year trends
- Verify an organization's 501(c)(3) tax-exempt standing
- Map who funds whom: a nonprofit's institutional funders, a foundation's grantees, and grant histories
- Understand a funder's giving profile by cause area and geography, or spot funder overlap across organizations
- Discover new nonprofits and funders by cause, geography, type, and size

Every answer is source-attributed and links back to the full record on Impala so you can verify the underlying data. All tools are read-only. Connecting creates a free Impala account; some tools may require a premium Impala subscription.
plugin_asdk_app_6a8c7c22d4188191b3619be5.longDescriptionZh:
更智能的数据，更大的影响力，就在您的人工智能工作流程中。 Impala 的连接器为您提供有关任何美国非营利组织或基金会的即时组织和资助者信息，这些信息是从包含超过 200 万个非营利组织、超过 25 万个资助者以及基于经过验证的注册机构、政府数据库和直接合作伙伴建立的超过 2500 万笔赠款的数据库中实时提取的。

专为推动慈善事业的团队而打造：赠款管理、项目、开发、资助者网络和顾问。要求它：

- 研究任何非营利组织或基金会：使命、计划、领导力、董事会以及如何申请
- 通过 990 表格损益表、资产负债表、关键比率和多年趋势检查财务状况
- 验证组织的 501(c)(3) 免税资格
- 绘制谁资助谁的地图：非营利组织的资助者、基金会的受资助者以及资助历史
- 按事业领域和地理位置了解资助者的捐赠概况，或发现组织中资助者的重叠情况
- 按事业、地理位置、类型和规模发现新的非营利组织和资助者

每个答案都有来源，并链接回 Impala 上的完整记录，以便您可以验证基础数据。所有工具都是只读的。连接创建一个免费的 Impala 帐户；某些工具可能需要高级 Impala 订阅。

plugin_asdk_app_6a6b00f513248191bbad865f.name: Logimu Shopping
plugin_asdk_app_6a6b00f513248191bbad865f.description: 查找亚马逊和沃尔玛产品
plugin_asdk_app_6a6b00f513248191bbad865f.productIntro: 在聊天时查找亚马逊和沃尔玛的真实产品数据。
plugin_asdk_app_6a6b00f513248191bbad865f.productIntroEn: Look up real product data from Amazon and Walmart while you chat.
plugin_asdk_app_6a6b00f513248191bbad865f.longDescription:
Look up real product data from Amazon and Walmart while you chat.

Ask an open-ended question ("a quiet burr grinder under $150") and get a
ranked shortlist with current prices, ratings and stock. Ask about a
specific product and get its price, stock status, rating, review count
and how many sellers are competing on it — plus how price and
availability moved over the last 30 days.

Data comes from a continuously refreshed warehouse of 17M+ tracked
products across Amazon US, UK, Germany, Canada and Australia, and
Walmart US. Every record carries the timestamp it was observed, so you
can tell how fresh it is. Ranking is based on the product data itself —
no affiliate links, sponsored placements or paid seller positions.

Works with no signup.
plugin_asdk_app_6a6b00f513248191bbad865f.longDescriptionZh:
在聊天时查找亚马逊和沃尔玛的真实产品数据。

提出一个开放式问题（“150 美元以下的安静毛刺研磨机”）并获得
根据当前价格、评级和股票排名入围名单。询问一个
特定产品并获取其价格、库存状态、评级、评论数
以及有多少卖家在竞争——以及价格和
可用性在过去 30 天内发生变化。

数据来自持续刷新的 17M+ 跟踪数据仓库
亚马逊美国、英国、德国、加拿大和澳大利亚的产品，以及
美国沃尔玛。每条记录都带有观察到的时间戳，因此您
可以看出它有多新鲜。排名基于产品数据本身 -
没有附属链接、赞助展示位置或付费卖家职位。

无需注册即可使用。

What are the best-selling coffee machines on Amazon Germany right now?

plugin_asdk_app_6a56387fe0688191b7028e7a.productIntro: ARIA 是 ChatGPT 内的消费者情报分析师。询问有关您的类别的问题（高蛋白零食、肠道健康、护肤品、客户关心的任何事情），ARIA 会阅读数百万条基于实际帖子和视频的真实社交对话来回答问题。 不必等待数周的研究平台，而是在聊天中获得答案：什么是趋势以及原因，您的品牌相对于品类领导者的认知如何，哪些主张和吸引力会引起共鸣，以及您的受众实际要求什么。每一个见解都有其背后真实对话的支持，因此您可以信任它并据此采取行动。
plugin_asdk_app_6a56387fe0688191b7028e7a.productIntroEn: ARIA is your consumer-intelligence analyst inside ChatGPT. Ask a question about your category — high-protein snacking, gut health, skincare, anything your customers care about — and ARIA reads across millions of real social conversations to answer it, grounded in actual posts and videos.
plugin_asdk_app_6a56387fe0688191b7028e7a.longDescription:
ARIA is your consumer-intelligence analyst inside ChatGPT. Ask a question about your category — high-protein snacking, gut health, skincare, anything your customers care about — and ARIA reads across millions of real social conversations to answer it, grounded in actual posts and videos.
Instead of waiting weeks for a research deck, get the answer in the chat: what's trending and why, how your brand is perceived versus the category leader, which claims and hooks resonate, and what your audience is actually asking for. Every insight is backed by the real conversations behind it, so you can trust it and act on it.
Use ARIA to spot emerging trends early, validate product and campaign ideas, understand brand sentiment, and find the language your customers already use. Built for brand, marketing, insights, and product teams who want to talk to their market without running a single survey.
Connect your ARIA account and start asking.
plugin_asdk_app_6a56387fe0688191b7028e7a.longDescriptionZh:
ARIA 是 ChatGPT 内的消费者情报分析师。询问有关您的类别的问题（高蛋白零食、肠道健康、护肤品、客户关心的任何事情），ARIA 会阅读数百万条基于实际帖子和视频的真实社交对话来回答问题。
不必等待数周的研究平台，而是在聊天中获得答案：什么是趋势以及原因，您的品牌相对于品类领导者的认知如何，哪些主张和吸引力会引起共鸣，以及您的受众实际要求什么。每一个见解都有其背后真实对话的支持，因此您可以信任它并据此采取行动。
使用 ARIA 尽早发现新兴趋势、验证产品和活动创意、了解品牌情绪并找到客户已经使用的语言。专为希望在不进行单一调查的情况下与市场对话的品牌、营销、洞察和产品团队而设计。

plugin_asdk_app_6a77262c3e1081919ffd4996.productIntro: “我的汽车座椅被召回了吗？”值得比“去搜索两个政府网站”更好的答案。 Recall Scout 将 NHTSA 和 CPSC 召回数据库放入您的助手中 - 车辆、轮胎、儿童汽车座椅、设备和消费品，每天更新。每个答案都带有危险、补救措施和官方召回链接，因此您可以采取行动，而不仅仅是担心它。诚实的边界：食品、药品和医疗设备召回 (FDA) 不包括在内，该工具也是这么说的。免费使用。由 SimonBuilds 构建和运行。
plugin_asdk_app_6a77262c3e1081919ffd4996.productIntroEn: "Is my car seat recalled?" deserves a better answer than "go search two government sites." Recall Scout puts the NHTSA and CPSC recall databases inside your assistant - vehicles, tires, child car seats, equipment, and consumer products, refreshed daily. Every answer carries the hazard, the remedy, and the official recall link, so you can act on it instead of just worrying about it.

plugin_asdk_app_6a98d577cb1881919b34b0af.description: 构建结构化网络数据集
plugin_asdk_app_6a98d577cb1881919b34b0af.productIntro: Riveter 将网络研究转化为结构化数据。向 Claude 提供公司、人员或 URL 的列表，并要求提供新列：产品描述、收入、深度分析、公司人数、链接跟踪、定价、技术堆栈分析、联系方式、分类、摘要等。Riveter 每行运行一个 AI 代理，用于搜索、读取页面，并使用源答案填充每个单元格。
plugin_asdk_app_6a98d577cb1881919b34b0af.productIntroEn: Riveter turns web research into structured data. Give Claude a list of companies, people, or URLs and ask for new columns: product descriptions, revenue, deep analysis, company headcount, link traces, pricing, tech stack analysis, contact details, a classification, a summary, etc. Riveter runs an AI agent per row that searches, reads pages, and fills in each cell with a sourced answer.
plugin_asdk_app_6a98d577cb1881919b34b0af.longDescription:
Riveter turns web research into structured data. Give Claude a list of companies, people, or URLs and ask for new columns: product descriptions, revenue, deep analysis, company headcount, link traces, pricing, tech stack analysis, contact details, a classification, a summary, etc. Riveter runs an AI agent per row that searches, reads pages, and fills in each cell with a sourced answer.

What you can do

- Enrich rows you already have. Paste a list or point at a saved enrichment and get the new columns back. Up to 10,000 rows per run.
- Build a list from a description. "Every lawfirm in Indiana", "every YC W24 company in healthcare", "competitors of Stripe". Riveter generates the rows, and can enrich them in the same run.
- Scrape a page. Clean text or markdown from any URL, including JavaScript-rendered pages.
- Search the web. One-shot search results, or a research agent that answers a question with a structured, schema-shaped response.
- Extract records from a site. Define the fields you want and pull them from listings, directories, or catalogs as JSON.
- Monitor for changes. Run a saved enrichment daily, weekly, or monthly and get alerts or webhooks when values change.

How it works

Long runs are asynchronous. Claude starts the run, checks status, and fetches results when they are ready. Every run has an id you can come back to later, and results stay available in your Riveter account.
plugin_asdk_app_6a98d577cb1881919b34b0af.longDescriptionZh:
Riveter 将网络研究转化为结构化数据。向 Claude 提供公司、人员或 URL 的列表，并要求提供新列：产品描述、收入、深度分析、公司人数、链接跟踪、定价、技术堆栈分析、联系方式、分类、摘要等。Riveter 每行运行一个 AI 代理，用于搜索、读取页面，并使用源答案填充每个单元格。

你能做什么

- 丰富您已有的行。将列表或点粘贴到已保存的丰富内容并取回新列。每次运行最多 10,000 行。
- 根据描述构建列表。 “印第安纳州的每家律师事务所”、“医疗保健领域的每家 YC W24 公司”、“Stripe 的竞争对手”。 Riveter 生成行，并可以在同一运行中丰富它们。
- 刮一页。来自任何 URL 的干净文本或 Markdown，包括 JavaScript 渲染的页面。
- 搜索网络。一次性搜索结果，或者是一个以结构化、模式化的响应来回答问题的研究代理。
- 从站点提取记录。定义所需的字段并以 JSON 形式从列表、目录或目录中提取它们。
- 监控变化。每天、每周或每月运行保存的丰富内容，并在值发生变化时获取警报或 Webhooks。

它是如何运作的

长距离运行是异步的。 Claude 开始运行，检查状态，并在结果准备好时获取结果。每次运行都有一个 ID，您可以稍后返回，并且结果保留在您的 Riveter 帐户中。
