plugin_asdk_app_6a8fe0e4c28481919a6289d2.name: Cargo
plugin_asdk_app_6a8fe0e4c28481919a6289d2.description: 您在 ChatGPT 中的 GTM
plugin_asdk_app_6a8fe0e4c28481919a6289d2.productIntro: Cargo 是人工智能助手的 GTM 基础设施。连接此 MCP 服务器和 ChatGPT 可以操作您的 Cargo 工作区：跨 130 多个集成发现并运行操作、执行工具和代理、查询 CRM 和收入模型，以及阅读您的团队已编写的剧本和 ICP 上下文。
plugin_asdk_app_6a8fe0e4c28481919a6289d2.productIntroEn: Cargo is GTM infrastructure for AI assistants. Connect this MCP server and ChatGPT can operate your Cargo workspace: discover and run actions across 130+ integrations, execute tools and agents, query CRM and revenue models, and read the playbooks and ICP context your team already wrote.
plugin_asdk_app_6a8fe0e4c28481919a6289d2.longDescription:
Cargo is GTM infrastructure for AI assistants. Connect this MCP server and ChatGPT can operate your Cargo workspace: discover and run actions across 130+ integrations, execute tools and agents, query CRM and revenue models, and read the playbooks and ICP context your team already wrote.

Sign in with OAuth — no API key to paste. Your session binds to one workspace, so ChatGPT sees your integrations, your models, and your credits.

What you can do from chat:
• Search the action catalog and see credit cost before anything runs
• Enrich people and companies, look up CRM records, and call native platform ops
• Run a single action or a batch across many records
• Query workspace models (selects, joins, aggregates)
• Read workspace context — ICP definitions, playbooks, rubrics — before guessing

Ask in plain English. ChatGPT finds the right action, confirms cost when it matters, and brings results back into the conversation.

Best for RevOps, sales ops, and GTM engineers who want research-to-action without leaving chat. Building multi-step workflows or workspace-as-code stays in the Cargo CLI — this connector is the runtime for in-conversation work.

Learn more: https://www.getcargo.ai/mcp
plugin_asdk_app_6a8fe0e4c28481919a6289d2.longDescriptionZh:
Cargo 是人工智能助手的 GTM 基础设施。连接此 MCP 服务器和 ChatGPT 可以操作您的 Cargo 工作区：跨 130 多个集成发现并运行操作、执行工具和代理、查询 CRM 和收入模型，以及阅读您的团队已编写的剧本和 ICP 上下文。

使用 OAuth 登录 — 无需粘贴 API 密钥。您的会话绑定到一个工作区，因此 ChatGPT 可以看到您的集成、模型和积分。

您可以通过聊天执行以下操作：
• 在任何操作运行之前搜索操作目录并查看信用成本
• 丰富人员和公司、查找 CRM 记录并调用本机平台操作员
• 跨多个记录运行单个操作或批处理
• 查询工作区模型（选择、联接、聚合）
• 在猜测之前阅读工作区上下文 - ICP 定义、手册、规则

用简单的英语询问。 ChatGPT 找到正确的操作，在重要时确认成本，并将结果带回到对话中。

最适合希望在不离开聊天的情况下从研究到行动的 RevOps、销售运营人员和 GTM 工程师。构建多步骤工作流程或工作区即代码保留在 Cargo CLI 中 - 该连接器是对话中工作的运行时。

了解更多：https://www.getcargo.ai/mcp

Find 50 companies that look like our best customers, and tell me what enrichment would cost before running it.
Does this account fit our ICP? Check our workspace context, then summarize the match.

plugin_asdk_app_6a885c35ba808191afabe76f.productIntro: Docket Demand MCP 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的 Docket 帐户，这样您就可以用简单的英语询问有关您的网站 AI 代理正在捕获的需求的问题，而无需打开仪表板。
plugin_asdk_app_6a885c35ba808191afabe76f.productIntroEn: Docket Demand MCP connects ChatGPT to your Docket account so you can ask questions about the demand your website AI agents are capturing — in plain English, without opening a dashboard.
plugin_asdk_app_6a885c35ba808191afabe76f.longDescription:
Docket Demand MCP connects ChatGPT to your Docket account so you can ask questions about the demand your website AI agents are capturing — in plain English, without opening a dashboard.

Ask about your Website Agents and how they are performing, the visitors and leads they captured, the companies those leads work for, and the conversations they had. Get counts, trends, period-over-period comparisons, and conversation analysis — pain points raised, products visitors asked about, discovery questions, and agreed next steps — plus your agent-attributed meeting bookings.

The connector is strictly read-only. It cannot create, change, or delete anything in Docket. Every request is scoped to your own company's data and to your role's access level, enforced server-side and written to an audit log. Nothing is shared across customers.

You need an existing Docket account whose organization has MCP access enabled. Sign in with your Docket credentials when you connect; ChatGPT sees only the data your Docket role already allows you to see.
plugin_asdk_app_6a885c35ba808191afabe76f.longDescriptionZh:
Docket Demand MCP 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的 Docket 帐户，这样您就可以用简单的英语询问有关您的网站 AI 代理正在捕获的需求的问题，而无需打开仪表板。

询问您的网站代理以及他们的表现、他们捕获的访问者和潜在客户、这些潜在客户所在的公司以及他们进行的对话。获取计数、趋势、期间比较和对话分析（提出的痛点、访问者询问的产品、发现问题和商定的后续步骤）以及代理归因的会议预订。

连接器是严格只读的。它无法创建、更改或删除 Docket 中的任何内容。每个请求的范围仅限于您自己公司的数据和您角色的访问级别，在服务器端强制执行并写入审核日志。客户之间不共享任何内容。

您需要一个现有的 Docket 帐户，其组织已启用 MCP 访问权限。连接时使用您的 Docket 凭据登录； ChatGPT 只能看到您的 Docket 角色已经允许您查看的数据。
defaultPrompts: How many leads did we capture in the last 30 days?
Which website agent booked the most meetings this quarter?
Summarize this week's website conversations: what are the visitors asking about the most?
defaultPromptsZh: 过去 30 天内我们捕获了多少潜在客户？
本季度哪个网站代理预订的会议最多？
总结本周的网站对话：访问者问得最多的是什么？

plugin_asdk_app_698aea67410c81918f96f926.name: Sometrend
plugin_asdk_app_698aea67410c81918f96f926.longDescription:
Discover hidden trends with ease.

You don’t need data analysis experience to get started. Sometrend is your AI-powered social data partner, helping anyone quickly uncover meaningful insights and understand public reactions behind emerging trends.

Simply ask in your own words, like “Analyze the latest zero-sugar beverage trend,” and Sometrend will analyze vast amounts of social data to reveal the context and meaning behind the trend.

Turn trends into opportunities in ChatGPT and create new success.

This service does not perform analysis for the purpose of identifying individuals; it focuses on statistical and contextual analysis of social content. Excerpts from original posts or external links may be provided to aid understanding of the analysis results, but these are offered solely as internal references for analysis.
plugin_asdk_app_698aea67410c81918f96f926.longDescriptionZh:
轻松发现隐藏的趋势。

您不需要数据分析经验即可开始。 Sometrend 是您的人工智能驱动的社交数据合作伙伴，帮助任何人快速发现有意义的见解并了解新兴趋势背后的公众反应。

只需用您自己的话提出问题，例如“分析最新的零糖饮料趋势”，Sometrend 将分析大量社交数据，以揭示趋势背后的背景和含义。

在ChatGPT将趋势转化为机遇，创造新的成功。

该服务不执行以识别个人身份为目的的分析；它侧重于社交内容的统计和情境分析。可以提供原始帖子或外部链接的摘录以帮助理解分析结果，但这些仅作为分析的内部参考。

plugin_asdk_app_6a7d8ebcf0a08191ad00439b.productIntro: Circuitry 将 ChatGPT 连接到您组织的 AI 顾问，因此服务和保修团队可以直接从其工作所依赖的技术文档中获得答案。
plugin_asdk_app_6a7d8ebcf0a08191ad00439b.productIntroEn: Circuitry connects ChatGPT to your organization's AI Advisors, so service and warranty teams can get answers straight from the technical documentation their work depends on.
plugin_asdk_app_6a7d8ebcf0a08191ad00439b.longDescription:
Circuitry connects ChatGPT to your organization's AI Advisors, so service and warranty teams can get answers straight from the technical documentation their work depends on.

Ask in plain language and the matching advisor answers from the manuals, bulletins, and warranty booklets your Circuitry organization has loaded:

Auto Warranty Advisor explains vehicle warranty coverage and exclusions, duration and mileage limits, and how genuine replacement parts are covered.
HVAC Advisor covers installation and wiring procedures, fault codes, component specifications, and maintenance intervals for HVAC equipment.
Medical Device Advisor supports biomedical and field service teams with maintenance procedures, error codes, calibration steps, and specifications.
Lawn & Turf Equipment Advisor returns maintenance specifications such as tire pressures, fluid grades, belt routing, and service intervals by make and model.

Which advisors you see depends on your organization's configuration — ask to list your advisors to see yours.

Circuitry reads and explains. It does not file claims, place orders, or change any record in your systems, and it does not read live equipment status. Access is scoped to your authenticated Circuitry organization, so you only see documentation your organization has loaded.
plugin_asdk_app_6a7d8ebcf0a08191ad00439b.longDescriptionZh:
Circuitry 将 ChatGPT 连接到您组织的 AI 顾问，因此服务和保修团队可以直接从其工作所依赖的技术文档中获得答案。

用简单的语言询问，并从您的 Circuitry 组织已加载的手册、公告和保修手册中获得匹配的顾问答案：

汽车保修顾问解释了车辆保修范围和排除情况、期限和里程限制，以及如何涵盖正品更换零件。
HVAC Advisor 涵盖 HVAC 设备的安装和接线程序、故障代码、组件规格和维护间隔。
医疗设备顾问为生物医学和现场服务团队提供维护程序、错误代码、校准步骤和规格支持。
草坪和草坪设备顾问返回维护规格，例如按品牌和型号划分的轮胎压力、液体等级、皮带布线和保养间隔。

您看到的顾问取决于您组织的配置 - 要求列出您的顾问才能看到您的顾问。

电路读取并解释。它不会提交索赔、下订单或更改系统中的任何记录，也不会读取实时设备状态。访问权限仅限于您经过身份验证的 Circuitry 组织，因此您只能看到您的组织已加载的文档。
defaultPrompts: Can you list my advisors?
What type of gasoline is recommended for the Husqvarna MZ61?
Error code "E6" is displayed on the unit. What are the possible causes and required replacement parts?
defaultPromptsZh: 你能列出我的顾问吗？
建议为 Husqvarna MZ61 使用什么类型的汽油？
设备上显示错误代码“E6”。可能的原因和需要更换的零件是什么？

plugin_asdk_app_6a92b83f356881918b51987e.productIntro: 连接您的 Savri 或 Besökskollen 帐户，以探索您可以访问的网站的访客、流量来源、页面、目标和渠道。连接网站仪表板中的 Google Search Console 或 Bing 网站管理员工具，以读取搜索点击、印象、查询、页面和趋势。 Google 使用共享站点连接； Bing 对每个站点使用您自己的连接。搜索报告可从 Basic 获得。
plugin_asdk_app_6a92b83f356881918b51987e.productIntroEn: Connect your Savri or Besökskollen account to explore visitors, traffic sources, pages, goals and funnels for sites you can access. Connect Google Search Console or Bing Webmaster Tools in the site dashboard to read search clicks, impressions, queries, pages and trends. Google uses the shared site connection; Bing uses your own connection for each site.
plugin_asdk_app_6a92b83f356881918b51987e.longDescription: Connect your Savri or Besökskollen account to explore visitors, traffic sources, pages, goals and funnels for sites you can access. Connect Google Search Console or Bing Webmaster Tools in the site dashboard to read search clicks, impressions, queries, pages and trends. Google uses the shared site connection; Bing uses your own connection for each site. Search reports are available from Basic. The OAuth connection needs no API key; the separate API-key/npm route requires API access from Growth. Reports preserve each provider’s date coverage and limits. Bing weekly Web reports differ from its daily traffic totals. These tools do not provide separate AI citation counts or link a search query to a person or order. Search reports are read-only; managing sites, goals, funnels or event properties requires write permission.
plugin_asdk_app_6a92b83f356881918b51987e.longDescriptionZh: 连接您的 Savri 或 Besökskollen 帐户，以探索您可以访问的网站的访客、流量来源、页面、目标和渠道。连接网站仪表板中的 Google Search Console 或 Bing 网站管理员工具，以读取搜索点击、印象、查询、页面和趋势。 Google 使用共享站点连接； Bing 对每个站点使用您自己的连接。搜索报告可从 Basic 获得。 OAuth 连接不需要 API 密钥；单独的 API-key/npm 路径需要 Growth 的 API 访问权限。报告保留每个提供商的日期范围和限制。 Bing 每周网络报告与其每日流量总量不同。这些工具不提供单独的人工智能引用计数或将搜索查询链接到个人或订单。搜索报告是只读的；管理站点、目标、渠道或事件属性需要写入权限。

plugin_asdk_app_69f2e73b249c8191991ae2aa.productIntro: 探索西澳大利亚州的政府数据（其他州即将推出）
plugin_asdk_app_69f2e73b249c8191991ae2aa.productIntroEn: Explore government data in Western Australia (other states coming soon)
plugin_asdk_app_69f2e73b249c8191991ae2aa.longDescription:
Explore government data in Western Australia (other states coming soon)

GovScanner gives you real-time access to Western Australian government intelligence - question time answers, gazette notices, bills, Hansard debates, committee reports, tabled papers, acts, regulations and more - all searchable in chat.

Connect once and ask things like:
"What WA bills introduced this year have penalty clauses?"
"Find all gazette notices about liquor licence applications in the last 30 days"
"What has X politician asked the government about housing?"
"Show me highlights from the cannabis bill and its parliament stages"

Powered by GovScanner's MCP API - backed by 107,000+ question-on-notice records, 54,000+ Hansard entries, 22,000+ gazette notices, and more - updated instantly from official WA government sources.
plugin_asdk_app_69f2e73b249c8191991ae2aa.longDescriptionZh:
探索西澳大利亚州的政府数据（其他州即将推出）

GovScanner 让您可以实时访问西澳大利亚州政府情报 - 提问时间答案、公报通知、法案、国会议事录辩论、委员会报告、提交文件、法案、法规等 - 所有这些都可以在聊天中搜索。

连接一次并询问以下问题：
“西澳今年推出的哪些法案有处罚条款？”
“查找过去 30 天内有关酒牌申请的所有宪报公告”
“X政客就住房问题向政府提出了什么要求？”
“让我看看大麻法案及其议会阶段的亮点”

由 GovScanner 的 MCP API 提供支持 - 由 107,000 多个通知问题记录、54,000 多个 Hansard 条目、22,000 多个公报通知等提供支持 - 从西澳政府官方来源即时更新。

plugin_asdk_app_6a7b89064c80819186bd5562.name: Agentio
plugin_asdk_app_6a7b89064c80819186bd5562.description: 您的 Creator 广告数据
plugin_asdk_app_6a7b89064c80819186bd5562.productIntro: Agentio 是用于创作者广告的人工智能原生平台。品牌通过 YouTube、Meta 等购买创作者媒体。
plugin_asdk_app_6a7b89064c80819186bd5562.productIntroEn: Agentio is the AI-native platform for Creator advertising. Brands buy Creator media across YouTube, Meta, and beyond.
plugin_asdk_app_6a7b89064c80819186bd5562.longDescription:
Agentio is the AI-native platform for Creator advertising. Brands buy Creator media across YouTube, Meta, and beyond. 

This connector answers questions about your own Agentio account without opening the dashboard. 

Ask about performance on either platform. On YouTube: views, spend, CPM, view-through rate, 30-day views, link clicks and QR scans, and conversion reporting with cost per acquisition, revenue, and return on ad spend grouped by campaign, ad group, Creator channel, source, or attribution level. On Meta: per-ad performance and rollups, demographic breakdowns, and weekly reach. "What did we spend per acquisition last quarter?" becomes a question rather than a report you assemble. 

It also carries Agentio's product documentation, so "How is a 30-day view counted?" is answered from the same source as our help content instead of guessed at.

Access is read-only and scoped to a single brand, chosen when you sign in and enforced on Agentio's servers. A connection cannot change your data or reach another brand's account, and you can revoke it at any time from Agentio's integration settings. 

Requires an Agentio account.
plugin_asdk_app_6a7b89064c80819186bd5562.longDescriptionZh:
Agentio 是用于创作者广告的人工智能原生平台。品牌通过 YouTube、Meta 等购买创作者媒体。 

此连接器无需打开仪表板即可回答有关您自己的 Agentio 帐户的问题。 

询问任一平台上的性能。 YouTube 上：观看次数、支出、每千次展示费用、观看率、30 天观看次数、链接点击次数和二维码扫描，以及转化报告，其中包含按广告系列、广告组、创作者渠道、来源或归因级别分组的每次转化成本、收入和广告支出回报率。在 Meta 上：每个广告的效果和汇总、人口统计细分和每周覆盖率。 “上个季度我们每次收购花了多少钱？”成为一个问题而不是你收集的报告。 

它还带有Agentio的产品文档，那么“30天的浏览量是如何计算的？”答案与我们的帮助内容相同，而不是猜测。

访问权限是只读的，且仅限于单个品牌，在您登录时选择并在 Agentio 的服务器上强制执行。连接无法更改您的数据或到达其他品牌的帐户，并且您可以随时从 Agentio 的集成设置中撤销连接。 

需要 Agentio 帐户。
defaultPrompts: Which YouTube channels had the highest ROAS last quarter?
Which creative hooks are performing best on our Meta ads?
Which ad groups are ahead or behind on budget this month?
defaultPromptsZh: 上个季度哪些 YouTube 频道的 ROAS 最高？
哪些创意挂钩在我们的元广告上效果最佳？
本月哪些广告组超出或落后于预算？

plugin_asdk_app_6a99d92679e8819187a0fdda.productIntro: LocationLists 编制了品牌在其自己的官方商店或经销商定位器中发布的完整地点列表（Bobcat、Caterpillar、STIHL、Generac、Home Depot、Waffle House 等 260 多个）以及按州和协会成员名录列出的授权贸易承包商。
plugin_asdk_app_6a99d92679e8819187a0fdda.productIntroEn: LocationLists compiles the complete list of locations a brand publishes in its own official store or dealer locator — Bobcat, Caterpillar, STIHL, Generac, Home Depot, Waffle House and 260+ more — plus licensed trade contractors by state and association member directories.
plugin_asdk_app_6a99d92679e8819187a0fdda.longDescription: LocationLists compiles the complete list of locations a brand publishes in its own official store or dealer locator — Bobcat, Caterpillar, STIHL, Generac, Home Depot, Waffle House and 260+ more — plus licensed trade contractors by state and association member directories. Ask for a brand or a type of location, see how many records exist and which fields each row carries (name, address, city, state, ZIP, phone, latitude, longitude, website and brand-specific fields such as dealer tier or product lines), check when the file was last rebuilt, and view ten real rows. Full datasets are downloaded from locationlists.com.
plugin_asdk_app_6a99d92679e8819187a0fdda.longDescriptionZh: LocationLists 编制了品牌在其自己的官方商店或经销商定位器中发布的完整地点列表（Bobcat、Caterpillar、STIHL、Generac、Home Depot、Waffle House 等 260 多个）以及按州和协会成员名录列出的授权贸易承包商。询问品牌或位置类型，查看存在多少条记录以及每行包含哪些字段（名称、地址、城市、州、邮政编码、电话、纬度、经度、网站和品牌特定字段，例如经销商级别或产品线），检查文件上次重建的时间，并查看十个真实行。完整数据集可从 locationlists.com 下载。
defaultPrompts: Find every Bobcat dealer in the US and show me what the data looks like.
Which generator brands have dealer location datasets, and how many dealers does each have?
Show me ten sample rows from the STIHL dealer list and tell me when it was last updated.
defaultPromptsZh: 找到美国的每家山猫经销商，并向我展示数据是什么样的。
哪些发电机品牌有经销商位置数据集，每个品牌有多少个经销商？
显示斯蒂尔经销商列表中的十个示例行并告诉我上次更新时间。

plugin_asdk_app_6a7031251d588191809080c2.longDescription:
Churn Solution's MCP server gives AI assistants secure access to your cancellation and retention data. Using natural language, investigate why customers leave, measure the impact of your cancel flows, identify at-risk accounts and revenue, track retention trends, and answer complex questions about your subscription business.

Built for founders and growth, product, and finance teams, it turns Churn Solution data into actionable retention insights and faster decisions.
plugin_asdk_app_6a7031251d588191809080c2.longDescriptionZh:

它专为创始人和增长、产品和财务团队而构建，可将客户流失解决方案数据转化为可操作的保留见解和更快的决策。

plugin_asdk_app_6a9a1ebb11fc81919ef2aa72.name: Fullstory
plugin_asdk_app_6a9a1ebb11fc81919ef2aa72.productIntro: 询问您的产品分析，并获得可以验证的答案。
plugin_asdk_app_6a9a1ebb11fc81919ef2aa72.productIntroEn: Ask about your product analytics, and get answers you can verify.
plugin_asdk_app_6a9a1ebb11fc81919ef2aa72.longDescription:
Ask about your product analytics, and get answers you can verify.

Fullstory MCP connects Codex and ChatGPT to your product's behavioral data. Ask how many users adopted a feature, where checkout is leaking, or whether yesterday's release broke something, and Codex and ChatGPT builds the segment, computes the metric, and explains the result with a link back to Fullstory.

Analytics connectors can give you numbers. Fullstory shows you what happened. Metrics unpack into real session replay, so "conversion dropped 12%" becomes "the coupon field errors for logged-out users."

And because Fullstory autocaptures clicks, page views, errors, and frustration signals, many questions need no instrumentation at all. Ask about rage clicks on pricing or errors in checkout without shipping a single event.

What Codex and ChatGPT can do:
(1) Build and save segments and metrics.
Describe the users or behavior you care about in your own words; Codex and ChatGPT create segments or metrics in Fullstory where your whole team can reuse it.

(2) Compute on demand.
 Counts, rates, trends, and breakdowns by device, browser, geography, or user property, over any time window.

(3) Speak your product's language. 
Codex and ChatGPT discover your pages, named elements, and defined events, so questions map to your real product vocabulary instead of guessed selectors.

(4) Analyze conversion.
Read your saved funnels and measure where users drop and why.

(5) Back every number with sessions.
Retrieve the sessions and events behind any metric, including frustration signals like rage clicks and dead clicks.

(6) Read sessions at scale.
Ask Codex and ChatGPT to review dozens of sessions behind a drop-off or an alert and report the patterns, including failures that never reached your error tracker.

Teams use it to let PMs, support, and engineers self-serve answers that used to queue behind an analyst, and to settle "why did this number move?" with evidence instead of theories.
plugin_asdk_app_6a9a1ebb11fc81919ef2aa72.longDescriptionZh:
询问您的产品分析，并获得可以验证的答案。

Fullstory MCP 将 Codex 和 ChatGPT 连接到您产品的行为数据。询问有多少用户采用了某项功能、哪里结账存在泄漏，或者昨天的发布是否破坏了某些内容，Codex 和 ChatGPT 会构建细分、计算指标，并通过返回 Fullstory 的链接解释结果。

分析连接器可以为您提供数字。 Fullstory 向您展示发生了什么。指标会解压到真实的会话重播中，因此“转化率下降了 12%”变成了“注销用户的优惠券字段错误”。

由于 Fullstory 自动捕获点击次数、页面浏览量、错误和沮丧信号，因此许多问题根本不需要仪器。询问定价上的愤怒点击或结帐错误，而无需运送任何活动。

Codex 和 ChatGPT 可以做什么：
(1) 构建并保存细分和指标。
用自己的话描述您关心的用户或行为； Codex 和 ChatGPT 在 Fullstory 中创建分段或指标，您的整个团队都可以重复使用它。

(2)按需计算。
 在任何时间窗口内按设备、浏览器、地理位置或用户属性进行计数、比率、趋势和细分。

(3) 使用您的产品语言。 
Codex 和 ChatGPT 会发现您的页面、命名元素和定义的事件，因此问题会映射到您的真实产品词汇，而不是猜测的选择器。

(4)分析转化。
阅读您保存的渠道并衡量用户流失的位置和原因。

(5) 用会话来支持每个数字。
检索任何指标背后的会话和事件，包括愤怒点击和死点击等挫败信号。

(6) 大规模阅读会话。
要求 Codex 和 ChatGPT 检查掉线或警报背后的数十个会话并报告模式，包括从未到达错误跟踪器的故障。

团队使用它来让项目经理、支持人员和工程师自助提供过去需要在分析师后面排队的答案，并解决“为什么这个数字发生了变化？”用证据而不是理论。

plugin_asdk_app_6a95e0ac99a08191bc9116e4.longDescription:

The Dash Social MCP connects your brand, performance, competitive, and community intelligence directly to ChatGPT. Instead of manually copying data between platforms, ChatGPT gets the real-time brand context it needs to deliver more relevant, on-brand recommendations and actions.
Here are a few ways teams are already using the Dash Social MCP to elevate their social media management:
- Performance Reporting: Ask ChatGPT to pull the latest data from Dash and populate your team's reporting template, then share it via Slack once it's approved. No more manual data pulls.
- Post Performance and Creative Intelligence: Dig into post-level data across channels, including owned and UGC content. Analyze performance by post type, format, and theme without building manual reports.
- Content Scheduling: Identify gaps in your calendar, pull assets from your content library, draft them into posts across brands and channels, and schedule directly into Dash at your best times to post.
- Brand Health Monitoring: Set up a workflow that checks for shifts in mention volume or negative sentiment and alerts your team with actionable takeaways the moment something changes.
- Community Insights: Surface what your audience is saying. The MCP gives you access to comment and DM data, top keywords, sentiment breakdowns, and community overview metrics — all read-only, so nothing gets changed without your intent.
- Competitive Research: Ask ChatGPT to research your brand's positioning and public perception with Dash's competitive benchmarks and industry data built right in.
These are just some of the possibilities, but the only limit is your imagination.

plugin_asdk_app_6aa7f950fdec8191a220906a.name: Redpine
plugin_asdk_app_6aa7f950fdec8191a220906a.productIntro: 网络搜索返回无法检查的摘要、付费专区和引文。 Redpine 返回文档的相关块。
plugin_asdk_app_6aa7f950fdec8191a220906a.productIntroEn: Web search returns abstracts, paywalls, and citations that cannot be checked. Redpine returns the relevant chunk of the document.
plugin_asdk_app_6aa7f950fdec8191a220906a.longDescription:
Web search returns abstracts, paywalls, and citations that cannot be checked. Redpine returns the relevant chunk of the document.

Redpine licenses full-text research directly from publishers and research institutions, and serves it to ChatGPT/Codex over MCP alongside a large open-access corpus. One query searches both.

Provenance by default. Every result carries its publisher, title, publication date, and a resolvable identifier such as a DOI. Licensed content and open-access content are labeled separately, so the two are never confused inside an answer.

You see the price first. Any search can be previewed for free. ChatGPT/Codex sees the title, source, and a snippet of every result, plus the exact cost to unlock them, then asks before spending anything. Unlock the three results that matter instead of the 30 that came back. The same results re-fetch free for seven days. Discovery, schema inspection, previews, and balance checks are always free.

Built for questions where being wrong is expensive. Clinical decisions, systematic review, research engineering, and any analysis that has to survive a source check.

An account can also hold data integrations beyond literature. ChatGPT/Codex reads what that account is entitled to at runtime rather than assuming a fixed tool list.

Compensation flows back to the rights holders. New accounts get free queries. Credits are bought on the Redpine dashboard, and the connector never handles payment details: it shows the price and asks before anything is charged.

Requires a Redpine account. Sign-in is OAuth on first use.
plugin_asdk_app_6aa7f950fdec8191a220906a.longDescriptionZh:
网络搜索返回无法检查的摘要、付费专区和引文。 Redpine 返回文档的相关块。

Redpine 直接从出版商和研究机构获得全文研究许可，并通过 MCP 将其与大型开放获取语料库一起提供给 ChatGPT/Codex。一个查询同时搜索两者。

默认出处。每个结果都带有其发布者、标题、发布日期和可解析的标识符（例如 DOI）。许可内容和开放获取内容是分开标记的，因此两者在答案中永远不会混淆。

你先看价格。任何搜索都可以免费预览。 ChatGPT/Codex 会查看每个结果的标题、来源和片段，以及解锁它们的确切成本，然后在花费任何内容之前进行询问。解锁三个重要的结果，而不是返回的 30 个结果。同样的结果可在 7 天内免费重新获取。发现、模式检查、预览和平衡检查始终免费。

专为错误代价高昂的问题而设计。临床决策、系统评价、研究工程以及任何必须通过来源检查的分析。

帐户还可以保存文献之外的数据集成。 ChatGPT/Codex 在运行时读取该帐户有权使用的内容，而不是假设固定的工具列表。

补偿金回流至权利人。新帐户可免费查询。积分是在 Redpine 仪表板上购买的，连接器从不处理付款详细信息：它显示价格并在收费之前询问。

需要 Redpine 帐户。首次使用时通过 OAuth 登录。

plugin_asdk_app_6a8b50d183f081918339e17c.name: smart-me
plugin_asdk_app_6a8b50d183f081918339e17c.description: 读取仪表和电动汽车充电
plugin_asdk_app_6a8b50d183f081918339e17c.productIntro: smart-me 是一个建筑物计量平台。该应用程序将 ChatGPT 连接到 smart-me 帐户，因此您可以用普通语言询问您的仪表，而无需打开门户。
plugin_asdk_app_6a8b50d183f081918339e17c.productIntroEn: smart-me is a metering platform for buildings. This app connects ChatGPT to a smart-me account, so you can ask about your meters in ordinary language instead of opening the portal.
plugin_asdk_app_6a8b50d183f081918339e17c.longDescription:
smart-me is a metering platform for buildings. This app connects ChatGPT to a smart-me account, so you can ask about your meters in ordinary language instead of opening the portal.

You can ask what a meter reads right now, how much a heat pump or an apartment used over a period, what that costs at the current tariff, when the daily peak was, and how consumption developed over days or months. It reads quarter-hourly load profiles and daily series, the folder structure of a site, EV charging stations with their sessions and settings, load management groups, and the tariffs and consumption behind a building's energy bill.

With your confirmation it can also make changes: rename meters, create and organise folders, switch a relay, send a command to a charging station, set charging current limits, and set up the tariffs and units used to bill self-consumption in a shared building. Every change is shown to you before it happens. Deleting a folder or a charging station takes two steps, and the second one requires the exact name.

You need a smart-me account and sign in with it. Long series of measured values need a smart-me Professional licence; single readings work on any account. The app acts only inside your own account, with your own permissions, and stores nothing.
plugin_asdk_app_6a8b50d183f081918339e17c.longDescriptionZh:
smart-me 是一个建筑物计量平台。该应用程序将 ChatGPT 连接到 smart-me 帐户，因此您可以用普通语言询问您的仪表，而无需打开门户。

您可以询问仪表现在的读数、热泵或公寓在一段时间内的使用量、当前电价的成本是多少、每日高峰何时以及几天或几个月的消耗情况如何。它读取每刻钟一次的负载概况和每日系列、站点的文件夹结构、电动汽车充电站及其会话和设置、负载管理组以及建筑物能源账单背后的费率和消耗。

经过您的确认，它还可以进行更改：重命名仪表、创建和组织文件夹、切换继电器、向充电站发送命令、设置充电电流限制以及设置用于对共享建筑中的自用电量进行计费的费率和单位。每项更改都会在发生之前显示给您。删除文件夹或充电站需要两个步骤，第二步需要确切的名称。

您需要一个 smart-me 帐户并使用它登录。长系列测量值需要 smart-me Professional 许可证；单一读数适用于任何帐户。该应用程序仅在您自己的帐户内运行，具有您自己的权限，并且不存储任何内容。

plugin_asdk_app_6a8fd15c22f081919893ff04.productIntro: ProfileID 是由 GenuineIN 提供支持的值得信赖的数字职业档案。它将经过验证的教育、技能、能力、经验、证书、项目、认证和职业证据连接到一份智能档案中。通过 ChatGPT，用户可以安全地访问和使用其 ProfileID 数据进行职业指导、技能差距分析、工作准备、简历和作品集创建、机会匹配和个性化职业建议。
plugin_asdk_app_6a8fd15c22f081919893ff04.productIntroEn: ProfileID is a trusted digital career profile powered by GenuineIN. It connects verified education, skills, competencies, experience, credentials, projects, certifications, and career evidence into one intelligent profile.
plugin_asdk_app_6a8fd15c22f081919893ff04.longDescription: ProfileID is a trusted digital career profile powered by GenuineIN. It connects verified education, skills, competencies, experience, credentials, projects, certifications, and career evidence into one intelligent profile. Through ChatGPT, users can securely access and use their ProfileID data for career guidance, skill-gap analysis, job readiness, resume and portfolio creation, opportunity matching, and personalized career recommendations.
plugin_asdk_app_6a8fd15c22f081919893ff04.longDescriptionZh: ProfileID 是由 GenuineIN 提供支持的值得信赖的数字职业档案。它将经过验证的教育、技能、能力、经验、证书、项目、认证和职业证据连接到一份智能档案中。通过 ChatGPT，用户可以安全地访问和使用其 ProfileID 数据进行职业指导、技能差距分析、工作准备、简历和作品集创建、机会匹配和个性化职业建议。
defaultPrompts: Analyze my ProfileID and tell me my key strengths, skills, and career potential.
Review my ProfileID and identify my skill gaps and the top actions to improve my job readiness.
Based on my ProfileID, suggest the best career paths and opportunities that match my skills and experience.
defaultPromptsZh: 分析我的 ProfileID 并告诉我我的主要优势、技能和职业潜力。
查看我的 ProfileID 并确定我的技能差距以及提高我的工作准备度的首要行动。
根据我的 ProfileID，建议与我的技能和经验相匹配的最佳职业道路和机会。

plugin_asdk_app_6a8713d41dc48191b33e75c4.productIntro: Viral.app 跟踪并分析 TikTok、Instagram、YouTube 和 Facebook 上的 UGC 表现。该插件将 ChatGPT 和 Codex 连接到您的 Viral.app 工作区：查询跟踪帐户和视频分析、构建排行榜和 KPI 报告、管理跟踪、使用标签和标签工作流程组织内容、阅读 Creator Hub 活动以及在需要当前数据时提取实时平台数据。登录通过 OAuth 运行，并且仅限于一个 Viral.
plugin_asdk_app_6a8713d41dc48191b33e75c4.productIntroEn: viral.app tracks and analyzes UGC performance across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and Facebook. This plugin connects ChatGPT and Codex to your viral.app workspace: query tracked account and video analytics, build leaderboards and KPI reports, manage tracking, organize content with tags and tag workflows, read Creator Hub campaigns, and pull live platform data when you need current numbers.
plugin_asdk_app_6a8713d41dc48191b33e75c4.longDescription: viral.app tracks and analyzes UGC performance across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and Facebook. This plugin connects ChatGPT and Codex to your viral.app workspace: query tracked account and video analytics, build leaderboards and KPI reports, manage tracking, organize content with tags and tag workflows, read Creator Hub campaigns, and pull live platform data when you need current numbers. Sign-in runs through OAuth and is scoped to one viral.app organization; tools that spend billable credits always quote their cost first and only execute after you confirm. Requires a viral.app account with API access.

plugin_asdk_app_6a99c656d25881918909ef4f.name: Parse.ly
plugin_asdk_app_6a99c656d25881918909ef4f.productIntro: Parse.ly 是内容分析平台，出版商和营销团队用它来了解其内容的表现。此应用程序将 ChatGPT 连接到您的 Parse.ly 帐户，因此您可以用简单的语言询问有关您的网站的问题，并从您的真实数据中获得答案。
plugin_asdk_app_6a99c656d25881918909ef4f.productIntroEn: Parse.ly is the content analytics platform that publishers and marketing teams use to see how their content performs. This app connects ChatGPT to your Parse.ly account, so you can ask questions about your sites in plain language and get answers from your real data.
plugin_asdk_app_6a99c656d25881918909ef4f.longDescription:
Parse.ly is the content analytics platform that publishers and marketing teams use to see how their content performs. This app connects ChatGPT to your Parse.ly account, so you can ask questions about your sites in plain language and get answers from your real data.

Ask which posts did best this week, where your traffic comes from, how a specific article performed, which authors or sections lead, how many readers are on the site right now, and how your campaigns, conversions, goals and headline tests are doing. You can also search your posts, authors, sections, tags and campaigns, look up Parse.ly documentation, and manage goals and saved groups.

Sign in with your existing Parse.ly login. The app only sees the sites and data you can already see in the Parse.ly dashboard.
plugin_asdk_app_6a99c656d25881918909ef4f.longDescriptionZh:
Parse.ly 是内容分析平台，出版商和营销团队用它来了解其内容的表现。此应用程序将 ChatGPT 连接到您的 Parse.ly 帐户，因此您可以用简单的语言询问有关您的网站的问题，并从您的真实数据中获得答案。

询问本周哪些帖子效果最好，您的流量来自哪里，特定文章的表现如何，哪些作者或版块领先，目前网站上有多少读者，以及您的营销活动、转化、目标和标题测试的效果如何。您还可以搜索您的帖子、作者、版块、标签和活动，查找 Parse.ly 文档，以及管理目标和保存的组。

使用您现有的 Parse.ly 登录信息登录。该应用程序只能看到您已经在 Parse.ly 仪表板中看到的网站和数据。
defaultPrompts: How many readers are on example.com right now?
Where did the traffic on example.com come from this month?
What are the top 10 posts on example.com this week?
defaultPromptsZh: 现在 example.com 有多少读者？
example.com 本月的流量来自哪里？
本周 example.com 上排名前 10 的帖子是什么？

Connect your Amazon Seller Central data to ChatGPT with Adzviser. Ask questions in plain language to track sales, monitor orders, and see how your products are performing across marketplaces.

Compare ordered product sales, units ordered, sessions, and buy box percentage across date ranges. Break results down by ASIN, SKU, marketplace, or fulfillment channel. Turn your seller data into clear reports, spot trends, and see which listings are driving revenue.

plugin_asdk_app_6a9a0d539a68819185fe2d4e.name: MerchantFlow
plugin_asdk_app_6a9a0d539a68819185fe2d4e.productIntro: MerchantFlow 将 ChatGPT 连接到 MerchantFlow 工作区中的电子商务数据。探索损益、比较期间、按净利润对产品进行排名、审查广告支出并衡量商品成本覆盖率。其他功能包括订单、客户终身价值、库存、商店审核和报告。
plugin_asdk_app_6a9a0d539a68819185fe2d4e.productIntroEn: MerchantFlow connects ChatGPT to the ecommerce data in your MerchantFlow workspace. Explore profit and loss, compare periods, rank products by net profit, review ad spend, and measure cost-of-goods coverage. Additional capabilities cover orders, customer lifetime value, inventory, store audits, and reports.
plugin_asdk_app_6a9a0d539a68819185fe2d4e.longDescription:
MerchantFlow connects ChatGPT to the ecommerce data in your MerchantFlow workspace. Explore profit and loss, compare periods, rank products by net profit, review ad spend, and measure cost-of-goods coverage. Additional capabilities cover orders, customer lifetime value, inventory, store audits, and reports.

The connector provides read-only access to your authorized workspace through OAuth, including an interactive profit-and-loss view. Results reflect the integrations, available history, data coverage, and plan capabilities of your MerchantFlow account.

A MerchantFlow account is required. Access can be revoked from MerchantFlow Settings > Developer > MCP.
plugin_asdk_app_6a9a0d539a68819185fe2d4e.longDescriptionZh:
MerchantFlow 将 ChatGPT 连接到 MerchantFlow 工作区中的电子商务数据。探索损益、比较期间、按净利润对产品进行排名、审查广告支出并衡量商品成本覆盖率。其他功能包括订单、客户终身价值、库存、商店审核和报告。

连接器通过 OAuth 提供对授权工作区的只读访问，包括交互式损益视图。结果反映了 MerchantFlow 帐户的集成、可用历史记录、数据覆盖范围和计划功能。

需要有 MerchantFlow 帐户。可以从 MerchantFlow 设置 > 开发人员 > MCP 撤销访问权限。
defaultPrompts: Summarise last month’s P&L and compare it with the previous month.
Which five products made the most net profit last month?
What percentage of revenue has accurate COGS coverage?
defaultPromptsZh: 总结上个月的损益并与上个月进行比较。
上个月净利润最多的五种产品是哪五种？
准确的销货成本覆盖率占收入的百分比是多少？

plugin_asdk_app_6aaa45d7a7f08191bcaf2ec9.productIntroEn: InfiniteWatch brings customer interaction data and operational context from voice calls, text conversations, and web sessions directly into ChatGPT. plugin_asdk_app_6aaa45d7a7f08191bcaf2ec9.longDescription:
InfiniteWatch brings customer interaction data and operational context from voice calls, text conversations, and web sessions directly into ChatGPT. Authorized sales, customer support, QA, CX, and operations teams can ask natural-language questions to uncover top issues, find supporting examples, analyze trends, compare channels, identify operational risks, evaluate agent performance, access relevant how-to guidance, and summarize customer interactions.

The connector uses InfiniteWatch authentication and organization selection. Each connection and tool call is scoped to the user’s selected organization, ensuring users can access only the data available to them within that organization.

The connector is read-only. It retrieves and analyzes existing InfiniteWatch data but cannot create, modify, delete, export, send, or otherwise change customer interaction data.
plugin_asdk_app_6aaa45d7a7f08191bcaf2ec9.longDescriptionZh:
InfiniteWatch 将语音通话、文本对话和网络会话中的客户交互数据和操作上下文直接引入 ChatGPT。授权销售、客户支持、质量保证、客户体验和运营团队可以提出自然语言问题来发现主要问题、查找支持示例、分析趋势、比较渠道、识别运营风险、评估代理绩效、访问相关操作指南并总结客户互动。

连接器使用 InfiniteWatch 身份验证和组织选择。每个连接和工具调用的范围仅限于用户选择的组织，确保用户只能访问该组织内可用的数据。

连接器是只读的。它检索和分析现有的 InfiniteWatch 数据，但无法创建、修改、删除、导出、发送或以其他方式更改客户交互数据。

Which agents had the lowest QA scores in voice calls from June 2026 through August 2026?

Research stored Crypto X discussions with your agent. Discover which assets are being discussed, explore author history, filter by known chain associations, and follow source links to inspect the evidence. plugin_asdk_app_6a006bea18648191a3a8512c.name: ConvRadar: CRO for GA4
plugin_asdk_app_6a006bea18648191a3a8512c.description: 审核您的 GA4 转化率
plugin_asdk_app_6a006bea18648191a3a8512c.productIntro: ConvRadar 可以找到您的网站失去转化的位置，并对首先要修复的内容进行排名。
plugin_asdk_app_6a006bea18648191a3a8512c.productIntroEn: ConvRadar finds where your site loses conversions and ranks what to fix first.
plugin_asdk_app_6a006bea18648191a3a8512c.longDescription:
ConvRadar finds where your site loses conversions and ranks what to fix first.

Connect your Google Analytics 4 property and ask for an audit. ConvRadar reads your own GA4 data and returns headline KPIs against the previous period, the biggest drop-off in your funnel, anomalies with significance testing, and 2-5 ranked findings, each matched against a curated library of 184 CRO hypotheses across 43 categories, built from published conversion research.

What you can do:
- Run a full conversion audit in one prompt
- Find the biggest leak in your funnel, and which segments caused it
- Compare mobile vs desktop, paid vs organic, or any two segments, with a significance test
- Check any page for load speed and mobile UX problems, no GA4 needed
- Benchmark your conversion rate and AOV against your industry
- Log the changes you ship and measure whether they actually helped

ConvRadar reads only aggregated GA4 metrics from the property you connect. It never reads raw user-level data, and never reads your ChatGPT conversations.

Built for e-commerce, SaaS, and lead-generation teams.
plugin_asdk_app_6a006bea18648191a3a8512c.longDescriptionZh:
ConvRadar 可以找到您的网站失去转化的位置，并对首先要修复的内容进行排名。

连接您的 Google Analytics 4 资源并请求审核。 ConvRadar 读取您自己的 GA4 数据，并返回与上一时期相比的标题 KPI、漏斗中的最大下降、显着性测试的异常以及 2-5 个排名结果，每个结果都与根据已发布的转化研究构建的涵盖 43 个类别的 184 个 CRO 假设的精选库相匹配。

你可以做什么：
- 在一个提示中运行完整的转换审核
- 找出漏斗中最大的泄漏，以及造成泄漏的部分
- 通过显着性测试比较移动设备与桌面、付费与自然或任何两个细分市场
- 检查任何页面的加载速度和移动用户体验问题，无需 GA4
- 根据您的行业对您的转化率和 AOV 进行基准测试
- 记录您发布的更改并衡量它们是否真正有帮助

ConvRadar 仅从您连接的媒体资源中读取聚合的 GA4 指标。它从不读取原始用户级数据，也从不读取您的 ChatGPT 对话。

专为电子商务、SaaS 和潜在客户开发团队而构建。

plugin_asdk_app_6ab27b92ae488191ad861ca8.productIntroEn: Normalic Assistant connects ChatGPT to your organization's Normalic account, so you can ask about your manufacturing data without leaving the conversation.
plugin_asdk_app_6ab27b92ae488191ad861ca8.longDescription:
Normalic Assistant connects ChatGPT to your organization's Normalic account, so you can ask about your manufacturing data without leaving the conversation.

Ask about workstation performance, production reports, detected insights and anomalies, product and operator productivity, and tracked tasks — the same assistant available inside the Normalic app.

Each person connects with their own Normalic login — there's no shared account or API key. Requires an existing Normalic account with the MCP Assistant feature enabled for your organization.
plugin_asdk_app_6ab27b92ae488191ad861ca8.longDescriptionZh:
Normalic Assistant 将 ChatGPT 连接到您组织的 Normalic 帐户，因此您可以在不离开对话的情况下询问您的制造数据。

询问工作站性能、生产报告、检测到的见解和异常、产品和操作员生产力以及跟踪的任务 - Normalic 应用程序中提供相同的助手。

每个人都使用自己的普通登录名进行连接 - 没有共享帐户或 API 密钥。需要现有的 Normalic 帐户并为您的组织启用了 MCP Assistant 功能。

plugin_asdk_app_6a9f12163d8881919c401fbf.name: Momently
plugin_asdk_app_6a9f12163d8881919c401fbf.productIntroEn: Momently is the data platform for modern publishers. It connects social, web, newsletter, and ad platforms in one place and turns them into live dashboards, branded campaign reports, and benchmarks. This plugin gives Momently customers a direct line to that data from ChatGPT.
plugin_asdk_app_6a9f12163d8881919c401fbf.longDescription:
Momently is the data platform for modern publishers. It connects social, web, newsletter, and ad platforms in one place and turns them into live dashboards, branded campaign reports, and benchmarks. This plugin gives Momently customers a direct line to that data from ChatGPT.

Ask questions in plain language and get real answers from your own workspace: how campaigns are performing, which platform drove the most impressions, how delivery is pacing against goals, which posts performed best this quarter, or how campaigns for a prospect's category usually perform based on your own history. Results come back with links into Momently, shareable branded PDF reports, and the actual creatives with thumbnails.

Everything is read-only and permission-aware. Each person signs in with their own Momently account, sees only the workspaces they already belong to, and every request is checked against their permissions on every call. The plugin cannot change anything in Momently.

Built for publisher teams: sales pulling benchmarks before a pitch, client services checking pacing and prepping wrap reports, editorial and social teams reviewing content performance, and leadership asking for the quarter in one question.

Requires a Momently workspace with the connector enabled. Visit momently.com/connector for setup guides.

plugin_asdk_app_6a70478942688191a503ed99.longDescription:
EBHOOM EMS is a read-only environmental monitoring assistant for authorized industrial users. It connects to the EBHOOM Environmental Management System to provide live station status, current parameter readings, exceedances, daily averages, and recent data-gap information.

The plugin does not modify monitoring data, change device configuration, control equipment, or perform administrative actions. Users can only access the stations and environmental data permitted for their authenticated account.

plugin_asdk_app_6a6107b1f2208191b28f565a.productIntro: YPulse 是一项专注于 Z 世代和千禧一代（13-39 岁）的研究服务，涵盖北美和西欧的青少年、青少年、大学生、年轻人和年轻父母，拥有十多年的联合调查数据。
plugin_asdk_app_6a6107b1f2208191b28f565a.productIntroEn: YPulse is a research service focused on Gen Z and Millennials (ages 13–39) — covering tweens, teens, college students, young adults, and young parents across North America and Western Europe, with over a decade of syndicated survey data.
plugin_asdk_app_6a6107b1f2208191b28f565a.longDescription:
YPulse is a research service focused on Gen Z and Millennials (ages 13–39) — covering tweens, teens, college students, young adults, and young parents across North America and Western Europe, with over a decade of syndicated survey data.

It tracks brand perception (awareness, favorability, usage), behavioral trends (spending, social media, entertainment, finance, health, dating), and publishes editorial content/reports on youth culture. It doesn't cover Gen X, Boomers, or anyone over 40.

plugin_asdk_app_6a7662c04e708191a3139c52.productIntro: Personyze 是一个 Web 个性化和 A/B 测试平台。此应用程序可让 ChatGPT 直接与您的 Personyze 帐户配合使用：了解营销活动的执行情况、检查和起草个性化操作、搜索和更新访客资料以及管理受众 - 在对话中，无需编写代码或打开面板。
plugin_asdk_app_6a7662c04e708191a3139c52.productIntroEn: Personyze is a web personalization and A/B testing platform. This app lets ChatGPT work with your Personyze account directly: read how campaigns are performing, inspect and draft personalization actions, search and update visitor profiles, and manage audiences — in conversation, without writing code or opening the panel.
plugin_asdk_app_6a7662c04e708191a3139c52.longDescription:
Personyze is a web personalization and A/B testing platform. This app lets ChatGPT work with your Personyze account directly: read how campaigns are performing, inspect and draft personalization actions, search and update visitor profiles, and manage audiences — in conversation, without writing code or opening the panel.

Typical uses: "which campaigns lost conversion rate last week", "add everyone who viewed the pricing page to the Enterprise Prospects audience", "draft a banner for returning visitors from paid search", "what did this visitor do before they converted".

Read and write are both supported; every action runs under the permissions of the account that authorized the connection, and access is revoked by deleting the API key in Personyze under Integrations.

plugin_asdk_app_6a7ed9d2070c8191b822a7a4.productIntro: ラッコキーワード：キーワード/競合分析ツール（SEO・マーケティング調査）。
plugin_asdk_app_6a7ed9d2070c8191b822a7a4.productIntroEn: ラッコキーワード（RakkoKeyword）は、日本最大級のキーワードリサーチツールです。このプラグインを使うと、ChatGPTとの会話から直接キーワードリサーチとSEO分析を実行できます。
plugin_asdk_app_6a7ed9d2070c8191b822a7a4.longDescription:
ラッコキーワード（RakkoKeyword）は、日本最大級のキーワードリサーチツールです。このプラグインを使うと、ChatGPTとの会話から直接キーワードリサーチとSEO分析を実行できます。

できること:
・Google・Bing・YouTube・Amazon・楽天などのサジェストキーワード取得
・独自データベースからの関連キーワード・よくある質問の取得
・LSIキーワード、他の人はこちらも質問（PAA）、同時ランクインキーワードといった関連トピックの探索
・月間検索数・SEO難易度・CPC・競合性の取得（月別推移つき）
・Google検索順位の実測
・競合分析: 任意のドメインが獲得しているキーワードと主力集客ページの抽出
・指定キーワードで検索流入を集めているページ・サイトの検索
・SEOライティング支援: 検索上位ページの見出し・共起語の抽出

活用例:
・SEO記事の構成案・タイトル・見出しの設計
・コンテンツ企画・ネタ出し、市場・需要調査
・競合サイトの自然検索の流入キーワード分析
・EC（Amazon・楽天）の商品リサーチ

日本の検索市場データに強みがあり、月間検索数の調査では海外の地域・言語の指定にも対応しています。利用にはラッコキーワードのアカウントが必要です。

plugin_asdk_app_6a5548420f6c8191a4b9ef2f.productIntro: Otnox 帮助供应商直接在 ChatGPT 中寻找和评估公共采购机会。
plugin_asdk_app_6a5548420f6c8191a4b9ef2f.productIntroEn: Otnox helps suppliers find and assess public procurement opportunities directly in ChatGPT.
plugin_asdk_app_6a5548420f6c8191a4b9ef2f.longDescription:
Otnox helps suppliers find and assess public procurement opportunities directly in ChatGPT.

What you can ask:
- Search open tenders by country, category, keyword, deadline and value across 85 national procurement markets in Europe, Latin America, Africa and Asia.
- Open a tender: buyer, deadline, estimated value and a link to the published notice.
- Look up a contracting authority: what it buys, how much, and which suppliers win.
- Check the competition on a tender: number of bidders, single-bidder history, recurring winners.
- Ask whether to bid: a fit assessment against your saved company profile. Each new assessment uses 5 assessment credits from your Otnox account.

On first use the app helps you set up your account: it asks which markets you sell in and what your company does, then saves the markets and the matching procurement categories to your profile.

An Otnox account is required. The markets and features available to you depend on your plan; the app says so when something is outside it.
plugin_asdk_app_6a5548420f6c8191a4b9ef2f.longDescriptionZh:
Otnox 帮助供应商直接在 ChatGPT 中寻找和评估公共采购机会。

你可以问什么：
- 按国家、类别、关键字、截止日期和价值搜索欧洲、拉丁美洲、非洲和亚洲 85 个国家采购市场的公开招标。
- 开标：买家、截止日期、估计价值以及已发布通知的链接。
- 查找订约机构：购买什么、购买多少以及哪些供应商获胜。
- 检查投标竞争情况：投标人数量、单一投标人历史记录、经常性获胜者。
- 询问是否出价：根据您保存的公司资料进行适合度评估。每个新评估都会使用您 Otnox 帐户中的 5 个评估积分。

首次使用时，该应用程序会帮助您设置帐户：它会询问您在哪些市场进行销售以及您的公司从事什么业务，然后将市场和匹配的采购类别保存到您的个人资料中。

需要一个 Otnox 帐户。您可以使用的市场和功能取决于您的计划；当有东西在应用程序之外时，应用程序会这么说。

plugin_asdk_app_6ab13c882c04819196d6c65e.description: 查找并验证联系人数据
plugin_asdk_app_6ab13c882c04819196d6c65e.productIntro: Enrow：查找并验证联系人数据。
plugin_asdk_app_6ab13c882c04819196d6c65e.productIntroEn: Enrow looks up and verifies professional contact details for specific, named business contacts, using the Enrow account of the user.
plugin_asdk_app_6ab13c882c04819196d6c65e.longDescription:
Enrow looks up and verifies professional contact details for specific, named business contacts, using the Enrow account of the user.

What it does:
• Find a professional email address from a full name and a company name or domain, one at a time or in bulk?
• Verify whether an email address is deliverable, including on catch-all domains, single or in bulk.
• Find a mobile phone number from a LinkedIn profile URL, or from a name and company, single or in bulk.
• Check your Enrow credit balance and registered webhooks.

How it works: 
Searches are asynchronous. 
A find or verify tool starts a search and returns an id. ChatGPT then retrieves the result with the matching get tool. Bulk jobs of substantial volume can take several minutes.

What it is not for: it does not search or read the mailbox of the user, write emails, look up general customer-service numbers, or provide personal (non-professional) contact details.

Requires an Enrow account. Get started at https://enrow.io.

plugin_templated_apps_6a9b05b3b5e0819197.longDescriptionZh: 直接从 ChatGPT 界面探索、搜索、查询数据并在 Sigma 中构建应用程序和仪表板。您可以在整个组织中搜索相关文档和元素，回答和迭代复杂的数据问题，并使用自然语言执行详细分析。
defaultPrompts: give me a summary of purchase data in the last quarter
create a dashboard that tracks changes in profit this year
build a sales pipeline forecasting application
defaultPromptsZh: 给我上个季度的采购数据汇总
创建一个跟踪今年利润变化的仪表板
构建销售渠道预测应用程序
plugin_templated_apps_6a9b05b3b5e0819197.bestFor: 官方功能与当前任务直接相关，且能定义可检查的输出时。
plugin_templated_apps_6a9b05b3b5e0819197.bestForEn: When the official capability directly supports a task with a verifiable output.
plugin_templated_apps_6a9b05b3b5e0819197.notFor: 仅凭名称判断有用；未确认账号权限、插件组成和官方能力前就授权写入。
plugin_templated_apps_6a9b05b3b5e0819197.notForEn: Choosing by name alone or authorizing writes before checking account access, composition, and official capabilities.
plugin_templated_apps_6a9b05b3b5e0819197.proofPrompt: 只读检查 Sigma 插件能提供什么资料或能力，并列出权限与限制；不创建、不修改、不发送。
plugin_templated_apps_6a9b05b3b5e0819197.proofPromptEn: Read-only check what the Sigma plugin can access or do, including permissions and limits. Do not create, modify, or send anything.
usagePath: 核对官方说明与插件构成
确认账号和数据授权范围
在 Codex 中做最小只读验证
确认结果后再执行写入
usagePathEn: Review the official description and composition
Confirm account and data permissions
Run a minimal read-only check in Codex
Allow writes only after reviewing the result
